cards.note: *And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.* (Jubilees 1:25). *Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.* (Matthew 11:11). *Children of the living Elohim (God)* is Hosea's name for the house that had been called Not My People: *in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* (Hosea 1:10), and Paul takes the same words up for the same gathering (Romans 9:26). Jubilees has the Father saying it of the ones He cleanses and circumcises in heart, and making every angel and every spirit know it. John announced that gathering; he was the voice at the edge of it. The ones inside the kingdom are the gathered themselves, known in heaven as His children, and that is why the least of them is greater than the one who pointed the way.
cards.s_text: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there has not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
cards.t_text: And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.

cards.note: *And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.* (Jubilees 16:5). *And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.* (Matthew 11:23). Jubilees records what Sodom was burned for and that it stays burned until this day. Yahusha (Jesus) reaches for the same city as the measuring rod and says Capernaum will fare worse. Sodom never saw the mighty works Capernaum saw, and had it seen them it would have remained until this day; the city that watched the blind see and the dead rise and did not repent carries a heavier weight than the city whose sins were open. Sight raises the account. The judgment of Sodom is not softened here, it is the floor, and Capernaum is being told it stands below it.
cards.s_text: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted unto heaven, shall be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in you, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
cards.t_text: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.

cards.note: *And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom.* (Jubilees 16:6). *And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.* (Matthew 11:23). Jubilees says the judgment of Sodom is not finished history but a pattern: Elohim (God) will execute it again wherever people do as Sodom did. Yahusha (Jesus) lays that pattern over Capernaum and then sharpens it. It will go harder with the city that saw the mighty works than with the city whose uncleanness earned the fire, because Sodom sinned without ever seeing the King, and Capernaum refused him to his face. The template Jubilees names is still in use, and the one who holds it has told us which cities fall under it.
cards.s_text: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted unto heaven, shall be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in you, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
cards.t_text: And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom.

cards.note: *And thus He created therein a sign in accordance with which they should keep Sabbath with us on the seventh day, to eat and to drink, and to bless Him who has created all things as He has blessed and sanctified to Himself a peculiar people above all peoples, and that they should keep Sabbath together with us.* (Jubilees 2:21). *For the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) even of the sabbath day.* (Matthew 12:8). Jubilees gives the Sabbath as a sign and says what the day is for: to eat, to drink, and to bless the One who created all things. The disciples walking through the grain, plucking ears and eating on the Sabbath, were doing exactly what the day was made for; the ones objecting had hedged the day with rules until eating became a crime. When Yahusha (Jesus) says the Son of Adam is Adonai (Lord) of the Sabbath he is not loosening the day. He is its owner telling what it is, a day for a peculiar people to eat and bless Him, not to go hungry. Jubilees was written long before those fences went up, and it already knew.
cards.s_text: For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.
cards.t_text: And thus He created therein a sign in accordance with which they should keep Sabbath with us on the seventh day, to eat and to drink, and to bless Him who has created all things as He has blessed and sanctified to Himself a peculiar people above all peoples, and that they should keep Sabbath together with us.

cards.note: *And every man who does any work thereon, or goes a journey, or tills (his) farm, whether in his house or any other place, and whoever lights a fire, or rides on any beast, or travels by ship on the sea, and whoever strikes or kills anything, or slaughters a beast or a bird, or whoever catches an animal or a bird or a fish, or whoever fasts or makes war on the Sabbaths:* (Jubilees 50:12). *How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.* (Matthew 12:12). This is the strictest Sabbath list in Jubilees, and it is worth reading what is on it: work, journeys, tilling, fire, riding, sailing, killing, hunting, fasting, war. Yahusha (Jesus) does not strike one item off the list. He points out what was never on it. Lifting a sheep out of a pit and healing a withered hand are doing well, not working, and *it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days*. The fence that had grown up around the day read *do no work* as *do no good*, and that is what he answers. Notice that Jubilees itself forbids fasting on the Sabbath; the day was for gladness and mercy from the start, and the Sabbath stands as it always has.
cards.s_text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
cards.t_text: And every man who does any work thereon, or goes a journey, or tills (his) farm, whether in his house or any other place, and whoever lights a fire, or rides on any beast, or travels by ship on the sea, and whoever strikes or kills anything, or slaughters a beast or a bird, or whoever catches an animal or a bird or a fish, or whoever fasts or makes war on the Sabbaths:

cards.note: *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* (Jubilees 10:11). *Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* (Matthew 12:29). At Noah's prayer the angels bound nine parts of the evil spirits in the place of condemnation and left a tenth loose on the earth under Satan. Binding is how heaven has dealt with these spirits from the beginning. When Yahusha (Jesus) says no one spoils the strong man's house without first binding the strong man, he is describing the work he was doing in front of them: the tenth that was left is being bound too, and every devil cast out is the house being spoiled. The full binding waits for the thousand years, when the angel lays hold on the dragon and binds him (Revelation 20:2), but it had already begun in Galilee.
cards.s_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.

cards.note: *And there will be great wrath from Yahuah (God) against the children of Yashar’el (Israel), because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the nations, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them so that there should be forgiveness and pardon for all the sin of this eternal error.* (Jubilees 15:34). *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31). Jubilees says a thing most readers do not expect from the book of the covenant: there is a sin for which there will no more be pardon. It is not a slip or a weakness. It is the children of Yashar'el (Israel) knowing the ordinance, forsaking the covenant on purpose, and treating the sign in their own flesh the way the nations do. Yahusha (Jesus) draws the same line in Matthew: every manner of sin and blasphemy can be forgiven, but the one who has watched the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) at work and called it something else has stepped past the place where forgiveness reaches. Both texts describe the same posture, a deliberate turning aside from what one has plainly seen, and both say the same thing about where it ends.
cards.s_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
cards.t_text: And there will be great wrath from Yahuah (God) against the children of Yashar’el (Israel), because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the nations, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them so that there should be forgiveness and pardon for all the sin of this eternal error.

cards.note: *And at that time Yahuah (God) will heal His servants, And they will rise up and see great peace, And drive out their adversaries. And the righteous will see and be thankful, And rejoice with joy for ever and ever, And will see all their judgments and all their curses on their enemies.* (Jubilees 23:30). *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* (Matthew 12:40). Jubilees says the servants of Yahuah (God) will be healed and will rise up and see great peace. Yahusha (Jesus) gave that generation one sign: three days and three nights in the heart of the earth, as Jonah was in the whale, and then up. His rising is the first of the rising Jubilees promises, the firstfruits of it, and it is the reason the rest can be counted on. The servants rise because their Master rose first, and the adversaries driven out and the peace seen afterward follow him out of the ground.
cards.s_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
cards.t_text: And at that time Yahuah (God) will heal His servants, And they will rise up and see great peace, And drive out their adversaries. And the righteous will see and be thankful, And rejoice with joy for ever and ever, And will see all their judgments and all their curses on their enemies.

cards.note: *And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.* (Jubilees 1:23). *Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.* (Matthew 12:45). A house swept and empty is the picture of a man delivered with nothing put inside him. Jubilees names what must go in: a heart circumcised, a holy spirit created in them, a cleansing that keeps them from turning away. Casting out is half the work; the other half is the Father making the house His own so there is no room when the seven come back. That generation had the devils cast out in front of them and would not take the new heart, and Yahusha (Jesus) says its last state will be worse than the first. Deliverance without the Father moving in is only a vacancy.
cards.s_text: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
cards.t_text: And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.

cards.note: *And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* (Jubilees 1:24). *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* (Matthew 12:50). Yahusha (Jesus) names his family by one mark: whoever does the will of my Father. Jubilees had already given the Father's own words for the same bond: their souls cleave to Me and to all My commandments, they fulfil My commandments, I am their Father and they are My children. The will of the Father is not a mystery hovering somewhere above the commandments; it is the commandments. John says it the same way later, *hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments* (1 John 2:3). The kingdom family is known by what it does, and what it does is keep the Father's Torah from a cleaving heart.
cards.s_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
cards.t_text: And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.

cards.note: *And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.* (Jubilees 11:11). *And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:* (Matthew 13:4). Jubilees shows the ravens as no accident of nature: the prince Mastema sent them to eat the seed before it could be ploughed in, to rob men of their labour, and the boy Abram drove them off seventy times in a day (Jubilees 11:19–20). When Yahusha (Jesus) explains his own parable he says the fowls are no accident either: *then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart* (Matthew 13:19). The birds on the way side are the same birds, sent by the same prince, after the same seed. The parable is not borrowing a farming picture; it is describing a war Jubilees had already named.
cards.s_text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
cards.t_text: And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.

cards.note: *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1). *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.* (Matthew 13:25). The enemy sowed while men slept, and the first sowing was in the days when the angels of Elohim (God) took wives of the daughters of men and bred giants. Jubilees names it here, 1 Enoch tells it at length (1 Enoch 6), and Genesis 6 keeps it. The tares are not a figure for bad ideas; the parable says they are the children of the wicked one (Matthew 13:38), and this is where that seed first entered the field. No one saw it coming. Men slept, and woke to giants.
cards.s_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.

cards.note: *For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.* (Jubilees 7:21). *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38). Noah tells his sons why the flood came: the Watchers went whoring after the daughters of men against the law of their ordinances, and from that uncleanness came the giants who devoured one another (Jubilees 7:22). Yahusha (Jesus) tells his disciples what the tares are: the children of the wicked one, planted in the same field as the children of the kingdom. Noah's account shows a seed that was never the Father's, growing beside the sons of Adam and devouring them. The flood cut it down once; the parable says it grows again in the field of the world, and the reapers wait for the harvest.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.

cards.note: *And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.* (Jubilees 4:2). *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38). The first tare in the field was Cain. Jubilees says plainly why he killed: Elohim (God) accepted Abel's sacrifice and not his offering. John writes the same thing in the parable's own words, *not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother* (1 John 3:12). When Yahusha (Jesus) says the tares are the children of the wicked one, he is not inventing a category; he is naming a line that begins in the first family and runs through the field of the world to the harvest. The two seeds were there from the beginning, and the first field they shared was a literal one.
cards.s_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.t_text: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.

cards.note: *For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el (Israel) to be His people.* (Jubilees 15:30). *And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Adonai (Lord), thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.* (Matthew 15:22). Not every child of Abraham is the chosen seed. Jubilees says it flat: Ishmael, his sons, his brothers, Esau, Yahuah (God) did not bring them near, though they were Abraham's children; He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people. The woman crying *Son of David* on the coast of Tyre and Sidon is not standing outside that choice. Yahusha (Jesus) says *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Matthew 15:24) and then heals her daughter, which means she is one of those lost sheep. Canaan was the ground of her exile, the merchant coast where the divorced northern house was swallowed up among the Gentiles (Hosea 8:8), not a verdict on her blood. She knew the Shepherd's voice and called him by David's name because she was a sheep before she ever heard him. The line Jubilees draws is kept; what the story shows is that the chosen seed had been scattered to places their brothers would never have looked.
cards.s_text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, you Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
cards.t_text: For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el (Israel) to be His people.

cards.note: *And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.* (Jubilees 15:31). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Jubilees explains the difference between the children and the dogs. Many nations and many peoples are all His, but over them He set spirits in authority, and those spirits lead them astray; Yashar'el (Israel) He sanctified and gathered out from among all the children of men to rule Himself. Moses sang the same thing: *when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel). For the LORD’S portion is his people* (Deuteronomy 32:8–9). The woman on the coast of Canaan lives among the people under those spirits, and her daughter is vexed with a devil, but when she calls him *Son of David* and keeps asking, she shows she is not one of theirs. Yahusha (Jesus) says the bread is the children's, and then gives it to her, because she is a child of the household the Father rules directly, a lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) scattered into the territory of the spirits (Matthew 15:24, 28).
cards.s_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
cards.t_text: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.

cards.note: *But over Yashar’el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.* (Jubilees 15:32). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Over Yashar'el (Israel) no angel and no spirit: He alone is their ruler, and He keeps them Himself and requires them at the hand of every power. That is why Yahusha (Jesus) says he was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) (Matthew 15:24). The Shepherd who said through Ezekiel *I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out* (Ezekiel 34:11) had come to do it in person. The woman on the coast of Canaan is of that flock, a daughter of the divorced northern house living in the land of her scattering, and the Shepherd who was sent only to the lost sheep found one of them there. He says the bread is for the children, she answers as a child who knows whose table it is, and he gives it to her (Matthew 15:28). The line is kept; she was on the inside of it all along, and the hearing revealed it.
cards.s_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
cards.t_text: But over Yashar’el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.

cards.note: *And (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations.* (Jubilees 16:17). *But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.* (Matthew 15:26). Abraham's other sons became nations and are reckoned with the nations; from Isaac comes one holy seed that is not reckoned among them. Paul says it the same way: *they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel) ... In Isaac shall thy seed be called* (Romans 9:6–7). Children and dogs at the table is the same distinction. The seed of promise has a name and a line, and Yahusha (Jesus) does not pretend otherwise; he tells her the bread is the children's. But he was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) (Matthew 15:24), and the coast of Tyre and Sidon was where the divorced northern house had been swallowed up among the Gentiles (Hosea 8:8). When she answers as one who knows the Master's table and he gives her the bread, he is not crossing the line; he is finding a child of Isaac's holy seed on the far side of her exile.
cards.s_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
cards.t_text: And (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations.

cards.note: *And after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai, which is between Elim and Sinai.* (Jubilees 50:1). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.* (Matthew 15:37). The seven baskets are not a random count. Jubilees closes with the Sabbaths made known in the desert of Sinai, days and years and jubilees all built on seven. The first feeding left twelve baskets, a basket for every tribe (Matthew 14:20); the second leaves seven, the number of the Sabbath and the finished week. The King who fed the crowds counts the way Sinai counts, in twelves for the tribes and in sevens for rest. A people raised on that count would have noticed what was left over.
cards.s_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
cards.t_text: And after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai, which is between Elim and Sinai.

cards.note: *And I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years: but the year thereof have I not told you till you enter the land which you are to possess.* (Jubilees 50:2). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.* (Matthew 15:37). Jubilees counts the land's rest in sevens: Sabbaths of years, and the jubilee at the end of seven sevens, as Moses laid it out, *seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years* (Leviticus 25:8). The two feedings count in the two numbers of Yashar'el (Israel): twelve baskets for the twelve tribes (Matthew 14:20), seven baskets for the Sabbath and the jubilee. A crowd fed and filled with seven baskets over is a picture of the rest the land was promised: enough, more than enough, and the count of the week on top. The bread was real, and so was the number.
cards.s_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
cards.t_text: And I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years: but the year thereof have I not told you till you enter the land which you are to possess.

cards.note: *Wherefore I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day, and one week and two years and there are yet forty years to come (lit. "distant for learning the commandments of Yahuah (God), until they pass over into the land of Canaan, crossing the Jordan to the west.* (Jubilees 50:4). *And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.* (Matthew 15:37). Jubilees counts forty-nine jubilees from Adam to the border of the land, seven sevens of jubilees, with the fiftieth opening as Yashar'el (Israel) crosses Jordan. Seven is the number this book counts the world's history in. When Yahusha (Jesus) feeds the crowd and seven baskets remain, the number lands on ears trained by that count. He had already stood in Nazareth and read *the acceptable year of Yahuah (Lord)* and told them *this day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears* (Luke 4:19, 21); the jubilee had a face. The seven baskets are the full measure left over when the jubilee is proclaimed.
cards.s_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
cards.t_text: Wherefore I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day, and one week and two years and there are yet forty years to come (lit. "distant for learning the commandments of Yahuah (God), until they pass over into the land of Canaan, crossing the Jordan to the west.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) said to us: “It is not good that the man should be alone: let us make a helpmeet for him.”* (Jubilees 3:4). *And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,* (Matthew 19:4). When the Pharisees ask about divorce, Yahusha (Jesus) does not go to Moses first. He goes behind Moses to the beginning, and Jubilees tells that beginning in the Father's own words to the angels: it is not good that the man should be alone, let us make a helpmeet for him. The one who made them male and female made them for each other, and that is the standard; what Moses allowed *because of the hardness of your hearts* (Matthew 19:8) sat under it, not over it. Both are Torah, and neither cancels the other. The King reads Torah from its first page and the hard hearts from the page where Moses met them.
cards.s_text: And he answered and said unto them, Have you not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) said to us: “It is not good that the man should be alone: let us make a helpmeet for him.”

cards.note: *And He awaked Adam out of his sleep and on awaking he rose on the sixth day, and He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said to her: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife; because she was taken from her husband.”* (Jubilees 3:6). *And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?* (Matthew 19:5). Adam wakes, she is brought to him, and he says it: bone of my bones, flesh of my flesh, taken from her husband. That is why there is a *for this cause*. A man cleaves to his wife and the two are one flesh because she was one flesh with him before she was ever separate from him. Yahusha (Jesus) quotes Genesis to the Pharisees, and Jubilees carries the same scene in the same words. Marriage is a return to one body that was divided; what Elohim (God) joined on the sixth day no court was made to split.
cards.s_text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
cards.t_text: And He awaked Adam out of his sleep and on awaking he rose on the sixth day, and He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said to her: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife; because she was taken from her husband.”

cards.note: *And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul.* (Jubilees 1:15). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Twelve thrones judging twelve tribes means twelve tribes will be there to be judged. Jubilees says how they get there: they turn to Him from among the nations with all their heart, and He gathers them from among all the nations. That is Ezekiel's two sticks made one, and Isaiah's *outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel)* and *dispersed of Yahudah (Judah)* gathered *from the four corners of the earth* (Isaiah 11:12). The regeneration Yahusha (Jesus) speaks of is a gathered people of Jacob's blood seated under Jacob's sons' names, not a church that has renamed itself Yashar'el (Israel). The scattering was real, the gathering is real, and the thrones are for real tribes.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul.

cards.note: *And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el (Israel). The blessing of Yahuah (God) will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.* (Jubilees 31:15). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28). Isaac's blessing on Levi at Bethel is a blessing of judgeship: princes and judges and chiefs over all the seed of Jacob's sons, speaking the word of Yahuah (God) and declaring His ways to Jacob. Yahusha (Jesus) seats twelve men on twelve thrones over the same seed. Judging in Yashar'el (Israel) was never only a courtroom; *Yahuah (LORD) raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them* (Judges 2:16). What Levi was blessed to carry at the altar, the twelve are given to carry at the throne, and the people under them are still the seed of the sons of Jacob.
cards.s_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el (Israel). The blessing of Yahuah (God) will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.

cards.note: *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.* (Jubilees 5:2). *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* (Matthew 24:37). Yahusha (Jesus) says his coming will look like Noah's days, and Jubilees says what Noah's days looked like: lawlessness increased on the earth, and all flesh corrupted its way, down to the cattle and the birds, every order out of its order. The word is lawlessness, Torah thrown off, and it is the same word the King uses for the end, *because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold* (Matthew 24:12). The sign of the end is not a world that never heard the law. It is a world that had it and corrupted its way, and a religion that teaches its people the law is done away with is not a bystander to that sign.
cards.s_text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
cards.t_text: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.

cards.note: *And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.* (Jubilees 5:19). *For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,* (Matthew 24:38). Before the flood no one's person was accepted but Noah's, and his sons were saved on his account. Everyone else was eating, drinking, marrying, ordinary life, *and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away* (Matthew 24:39). The ones the flood took are the ones taken; Noah was the one left. So when Yahusha (Jesus) goes on to say one shall be taken and the other left, the pattern he has just set up is the flood, and when the disciples ask where the taken go, the answer is *wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together* (Luke 17:37). Being taken is not the rescue. The accepted one is the one still standing when the water goes down.
cards.s_text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
cards.t_text: And as for all those who corrupted their ways and their thoughts before the flood, no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways, according as it was commanded regarding him, and he had not departed from aught that was ordained for him.

cards.note: *And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul.* (Jubilees 1:15). *Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):* (Matthew 28:19). The Father says He will gather them from among all the nations when they turn with all their heart and all their soul and all their strength, the words of the Shema (Deuteronomy 6:5) and of Jeremiah's promise, *ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart* (Jeremiah 29:13). Then the Son sends his disciples to all nations. The two fit together. The sheep are scattered through every nation, so the shepherds are sent through every nation; *teach all nations* is not a change of subject from the gathering of Yashar'el (Israel), it is how the gathering is carried out, because that is where the lost sheep are. The door is wide because the scattering was wide.
cards.s_text: Go you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
cards.t_text: And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul.

cards.note: *And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.* (Jubilees 1:23). *Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.* (Matthew 28:20). The last words of Matthew are a command to teach commandments. Jubilees tells how a gathered people will be able to keep them: a circumcised heart, a holy spirit created in them, a cleansing that holds. Jeremiah calls it *I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts* (Jeremiah 31:33); Ezekiel calls it *I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes* (Ezekiel 36:27). The commission is that same work of the heart going out: baptize them, then teach them to observe everything he commanded. He opened his teaching by saying *one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law* (Matthew 5:18) and closed it by sending men to teach the keeping of it. Grace is not the end of the commandments; it is the heart that can finally keep them.
cards.s_text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
cards.t_text: And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.

cards.note: *And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.* (Jubilees 1:25). *Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):* (Matthew 28:19). *Children of the living Elohim (God)* is the name Hosea gave to the house that had been called Not My People: *in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* (Hosea 1:10), and Paul quotes it for the same gathering (Romans 9:26). Jubilees has the Father using the name for the ones He gathers and cleanses, and making every angel and spirit know it. The commission goes to all nations because that is the place where it was said to them *not my people*; that is where they were sown. The disciples are sent to find the Father's children where they were scattered, so that what heaven already knows about them becomes their own.
cards.s_text: Go you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
cards.t_text: And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.

cards.note: thread:binding-of-the-watchers-typological-anchor-for-binding-the-strong-man | *No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.* The Markan parallel to Matthew 12:29's binding-of-the-strong-man — the same architecture, 1 Enoch 10's chaining of Azazel hand-and-foot and Jubilees 10's binding of nine-tenths of the malignant spirits underlying both gospel-witnesses. The King's ministry is the incursion that binds the strong-man so the captives can be released.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot* (Luke 17:26, 28). The Lukan version of the Noach-comparison adds the Lot-comparison.

cards.note: thread:the-gathering-of-the-twelve-tribes-and-the-thrones-of-judgment-in-jubilees-sirach-wisdom-and-testaments-xii | *Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations. And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me; That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* Luke uniquely positions the twelve-thrones / twelve-tribes-judging promise inside the Last Supper rather than at the rich-young-ruler hinge (where Matt 19:28 places it). Matthew anchors *in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el.* YOSHI #5: *judging* renders as Tanakh-sense ruling/administering (Shoftim-pattern), not narrower judicial-sentence — the twelve apostles administering / ruling the twelve tribes in the kingdom on the Shoftim-pattern Mosheh (Moses) established.
cards.s_text: You are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* Jubilees 10:11 names the binding of nine-tenths of the malignant spirits in the place of condemnation, with a tenth left under Satan's administration on the earth — the strong-man's remaining household. Mark 3:27's binding-then-spoiling is the King's incursion against that remnant: the strong man bound so his goods can be carried off, the captives of the tenth-part released.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.

cards.note: *And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) bade us to bind all. And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: "Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me... for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men."* (Jubilees 10:7-8.) Noah's prayer brings the command to bind ALL the malignant spirits; Mastema's negotiation leaves a remnant under restraint. Mark 3:27 names the strong-man whose house must be entered and spoiled — and the Beelzebub-accusation of Mark 3:22 mistakes the King's spoiling of Mastema's remnant for collusion with the prince of the devils. The binding the Father commanded is the architecture the strong-man-parable presupposes.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) bade us to bind all.

cards.note: *And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.* Jubilees 5:6 carries the same binding-of-the-watchers the Enochic library records — bound in the depths of the earth and kept separate. Mark 3:27's binding of the strong-man before his house can be spoiled walks the architecture Jubilees names: the rebel-administration is held under restraint, and the King's incursion is the spoiling that follows the binding.
cards.s_text: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
cards.t_text: And against the angels whom He had sent upon the earth, He was exceedingly wroth, and He gave commandment to root them out of all their dominion, and He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound in the midst of them, and are (kept) separate.

cards.note: *And forthwith Yahusha (Jesus) gave them leave.* That a remnant of these spirits operates on the earth at all is the Hebrew library's own framework: *And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said... let some of them remain before me... And He said: "Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation."* (Jubilees 10:8–9) The legion is part of the tenth-part left to lead astray; the King encountering and casting them out is the partially-restrained-spirits framework walked into a single deliverance.
cards.s_text: And forthwith Yahusha (Jesus) gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
cards.t_text: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”

cards.note: *And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.* The spirits beg to remain in the territory because remaining-to-lead-astray is their assigned work: *And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* (Jubilees 10:1) The Hebrew library names the demons' purpose as leading-astray-and-destroying; the legion's plea not to be cast out of the country is the plea not to lose the ground from which it does that work.
cards.s_text: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
cards.t_text: And in the third week of this jubilee the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.

cards.note: *And Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said "Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him."* Jubilees 4:7 names Shet (Seth) as the *second seed* Elohim raised up to Adam — the seed-line that carries forward after Hevel (Abel) is slain. Luke 3:38's *which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God)* runs the genealogy back through that very Sethite seed to Adam, *the son of Elohim.* The Hebrew library names the raising-up of the seed-of-Adam through Shet; the gospel traces the Formed-Son's genealogy back through that same seed to the Adam who was Elohim's own son. FRAMEWORK-CENTRAL: the seed-of-Adam lineage is the spine the whole framework rests on, and Jubilees names its first preservation by name.
cards.s_text: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”

cards.note: *And You know how Your Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant.* (Jubilees 10:5) The Hebrew library names the place of condemnation into which the spirits are imprisoned and held fast — Noach's (Noah's) prayer asks the Father to bind them there. Luke 8:31's Legion *besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep* — the deep is the place of condemnation Jubilees names. The spirits beg the King not to send them to the binding the library had already named as their appointed end. The Father alone exercises dominion over them (Jubilees 10:6); the King exercises it in flesh at Luke 8.
cards.s_text: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
cards.t_text: And You know how Your Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant, my Elohim (God); for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.

cards.note: *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* (Jubilees 10:11). *But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.* (Luke 11:22). Nine parts were bound at Noah's prayer and a tenth left loose on the earth under Satan. Satan is the strong man armed, keeping his palace with that tenth. Yahusha (Jesus) had just cast a devil out of a dumb man (Luke 11:14), and he tells them what it means: a stronger one has come upon him, overcome him, taken the armour he trusted in, and is dividing the spoils. The binding that began in Noah's day is being finished by the one stronger than Satan; every devil cast out is spoil carried from a house whose master is already beaten. The last of the binding waits for the thousand years (Revelation 20:2).
cards.s_text: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he takes from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divides his spoils.
cards.t_text: And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.

cards.note: *And He said: "I shall destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which I have created"* (Jubilees 5:4). The Hebrew library names the flood-decree of total judgment that fell in the days of Noach. Luke 17:27's *and the flood came, and destroyed them all* walks the same decree; the *destroyed them all* of the gospel is the *I shall destroy... all flesh* of the wisdom of Jubilees. The days-of-the-Son-of-Adam comparison the King draws rests on this flood-judgment pattern the Hebrew library carried in full.
cards.s_text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
cards.t_text: And He said: “I shall destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which I have created.”

cards.note: *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.* (Jubilees 5:2). *They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.* (Luke 17:27). Luke gives the surface of Noah's days: eating, drinking, marrying, until the ark door closed. Jubilees gives what was under the surface: lawlessness increasing, all flesh corrupting its way, every imagination of the thoughts of all men evil continually. The ordinary life Yahusha (Jesus) describes was not innocent. It was carrying on as usual on top of that corruption, deaf to the hammer on the ark. That is the warning for the day of the Son of Adam: not that people will be eating and marrying, but that they will be doing it with the law thrown off and the judgment already appointed, and never look up.
cards.s_text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
cards.t_text: And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way, alike men and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that walks on the earth-all of them corrupted their ways and their orders, and they began to devour each other, and lawlessness increased on the earth and every imagination of the thoughts of all men (was) thus evil continually.

cards.note: *And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know ... that these are My children, and that I am their Father.* (Jubilees 1:25) *Ye must be born again* (John 3:7) is the doorway into the *children of the living Elohim (God)* the Hebrew library names as the destination of the heart-circumcision. The new birth makes the willing into the children-of-the-living the prophets promised the gathered house — the same sonship Hoshea (Hosea) named for the scattered who were once *not my people.*
cards.s_text: Marvel not that I said unto you, You must be born again.
cards.t_text: And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them.

cards.note: *And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* (Jubilees 1:24) *That which is born of the Spirit is spirit* (John 3:6) names the Spirit-wrought life the Hebrew library describes as the soul that cleaves to Yahuah (God) and fulfils His commandments. The Spirit-birth does not lead away from the commandments; it produces the soul that cleaves to them — the same Spirit who spoke at Sinai writing the Torah inward and making the born-again a child of the Father.
cards.s_text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
cards.t_text: And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.

cards.note: *And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.* (Jubilees 1:23) *Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)* (John 3:5) walks the same architecture the Hebrew library already named: the cleansing (water) and the created holy spirit (Spirit) are one act of Yahuah (God) upon the circumcised heart. The born-of-water-and-Spirit of John 3 is the heart-circumcision and holy-spirit-creation of Jubilees 1, not a sacrament severed from the heart-Torah it writes.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.

cards.note: *Let Your mercy, O Yahuah (God), be lifted up upon Your people, and create in them an upright spirit, and let not the spirit of Beliar rule over them ... create in them a clean heart and a holy spirit, and let them not be ensnared in their sins from henceforth until eternity.* (Jubilees 1:20–21) Mosheh (Moses) prays for the very thing Yahusha (Jesus) tells Nicodemus is required to *see the kingdom of Elohim (God)* — a clean heart and a holy spirit created in the people from above. The new birth of John 3:3 is not a new religion but the clean-heart-and-holy-spirit creation the Hebrew library names as the work of mercy lifted upon the covenant people, not a credential the flesh can manufacture.
cards.s_text: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Let Your mercy, O Yahuah (God), be lifted up upon Your people, and create in them an upright spirit, and let not the spirit of Beliar rule over them to accuse them before You, and to ensnare them from all the paths of righteousness, so that they may perish from before Your face.

cards.note: *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year. And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah’s death, and from the day of Noah’s death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.* (Jubilees 6:17–18). *When the day of Pentecost was fully come* (Acts 2:1) — the day was the feast of weeks, Shavuot. The Hebrew library names what the feast is for: to renew the covenant every year. The Spirit falls on the covenant-renewal feast, not on a day that abolishes the covenant.
cards.s_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
cards.t_text: And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah-twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah’s death, and from the day of Noah’s death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.

cards.note: *For it is the feast of weeks and the feast of first-fruits: this feast is twofold and of a double nature: according to what is written and engraven concerning it celebrate it.* (Jubilees 6:21). Shavuot is the feast of weeks and the feast of firstfruits. Pentecost is the firstfruits day — and the three thousand added that day (Acts 2:41) are the firstfruits of the gathering harvest, the down-payment of the Spirit on the feast of firstfruits.
cards.s_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
cards.t_text: For it is the feast of weeks and the feast of first-fruits: this feast is twofold and of a double nature: according to what is written and engraven concerning it celebrate it.

cards.note: *And I will send witnesses to them, that I may witness against them, but they will not hear, and will slay the witnesses also, and they will persecute those who seek the law, and they will abrogate and change everything so as to work evil before My eyes.* (Jubilees 1:12). The Hebrew library foretold the very thing Stephen names — *which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them* (Acts 7:52). Yahuah (God) said the sent witnesses would be slain and the seekers of the law persecuted; the pattern is the conduct of the faithless in every age, not the mark of a people.
cards.s_text: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom you have been now the betrayers and murderers:
cards.t_text: And I will send witnesses to them, that I may witness against them, but they will not hear, and will slay the witnesses also, and they will persecute those who seek the law, and they will abrogate and change everything so as to work evil before My eyes.

cards.note: *And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.* (Jubilees 6:10). When the council writes *that ye abstain from … blood* (Acts 15:29), it stands on a covenant older than Sinai itself — the oath Noah and his sons swore *for ever throughout all the generations of the earth.* The blood-statute is no apostolic invention; it is the everlasting term of the covenant, carried from Noah to Sinai to the gathered.
cards.s_text: That you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.
cards.t_text: And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.

cards.note: *And do you command the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to eat no blood, so that their names and their seed may be before Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) continually.* (Jubilees 6:13). The abstaining from blood (Acts 15:29) keeps the *names and … seed* of Yashar'el (Israel) *before Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) continually* — the very purpose the everlasting statute names. The decree over the gathered is the keeping of the seed before the Father, the covenant term that holds the scattered in their lineage and their name.
cards.s_text: That you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.
cards.t_text: And do you command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) to eat no blood, so that their names and their seed may be before Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) continually.

cards.note: *for that day is more holy and blessed than any jubilee day of the jubilees: on this we kept Sabbath in the heavens before it was made known to any flesh to keep Sabbath thereon on the earth.* (Jubilees 2:30). The Sabbath was kept *in the heavens* before it was given to flesh on earth — a heavenly rest of which the earthly day is the appointed echo. So Hebrews can say *there remaineth therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God)* (Hebrews 4:9): the weekly Sabbath was always the sign of a rest that reaches into the heavens, the eternal rest into which the believer enters.
cards.s_text: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And they shall not bring in nor take out from house to house on that day; for that day is more holy and blessed than any jubilee day of the jubilees: on this we kept Sabbath in the heavens before it was made known to any flesh to keep Sabbath thereon on the earth.

cards.note: *Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them; as I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify (it) to Myself, even so shall I bless them, and they will be My people and I shall be their Elohim (God).* (Jubilees 2:19). Hebrews says *there remaineth therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God)* (Hebrews 4:9) — and here that very people is named as the people who *keep the Sabbath day,* sanctified to Elohim as his own. The keeping-of-sabbath and the people of Elohim are bound together: the Sabbath marks the people for whom the rest remains.
cards.s_text: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And He said to us: “Behold, I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples, and these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people, and will bless them; as I have sanctified the Sabbath day and do sanctify (it) to Myself, even so shall I bless them, and they will be My people and I shall be their Elohim (God).

cards.note: *Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.* (Jubilees 2:1). The same creation Sabbath Hebrews appeals to — *Elohim (God) did rest the seventh day from all his works* (Hebrews 4:4) — is here named *hallowed for all ages* and *a sign for all His works.* The seventh-day rest was woven into creation as a perpetual sign, the very rest into which *he that is entered... hath ceased from his own works, as Elohim (God) did from his* (Hebrews 4:10).
cards.s_text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And Elohim (God) did rest the seventh day from all his works.
cards.t_text: And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of Yahuah (God), saying: Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.

cards.note: *And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.* (Jubilees 4:2). *By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain* (Hebrews 11:4). Jubilees names plainly what Genesis shows and Hebrews weighs: Elohim *accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.* The acceptance is the witness; the rejected brother's murder follows the accepted brother's faith.
cards.s_text: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.
cards.t_text: And in the first (year) of the third jubilee, Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain.

cards.note: *And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.* (Jubilees 4:3). *By faith Abel offered... and by it he being dead yet speaketh* (Hebrews 11:4). Jubilees hears the same crying blood the writer of Hebrews hears: *his blood cried from the ground to heaven.* The dead man speaks still — the blood of the first faithful witness lifting its voice to heaven, the pattern of every righteous one slain for his offering after him.
cards.s_text: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.
cards.t_text: And he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven, complaining because he had slain him.

cards.note: *And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.* (Jubilees 4:23). *By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him* (Hebrews 11:5). Jubilees fills out the *was not found* of the Torah: Enoch *was taken from amongst the children of men,* conducted *in majesty and honour* into the Garden. The man who pleased Elohim is removed from the company of the dying and set in the place of the living.
cards.s_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And he was taken from amongst the children of men, and we conducted him into the Garden of Eden in majesty and honour, and behold there he writes down the condemnation and judgment of the world, and all the wickedness of the children of men.

cards.note: *And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived. And she bare a son in the third month, and in the middle of the month, at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born.* (Jubilees 16:12–13). *But he of the freewoman was by promise.* (Galatians 4:23). The Hebrew library marks the promise-child born to the appointed calendar of Yahuah (God): Isaac came *at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken... on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest.* The son of promise is born on a feast of the Most High — the very appointed times the no-gods' calendar (Galatians 4:10) counterfeits. Promise keeps the Father's set time.
cards.s_text: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
cards.t_text: And she bare a son in the third month, and in the middle of the month, at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born.

cards.note: *And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac."* (Jubilees 17:4). *Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.* (Galatians 4:30). The Hebrew record carries Sarah's words almost as Paul cites them: *Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.* The casting-out of the flesh-born is no late allegory but the remembered act of the patriarch's house — the promise-son alone is heir.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless what says the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
cards.t_text: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

cards.note: Jubilees 1:2 — *And Moses went up into the mount of Elohim (God), and the glory of Yahuah (God) abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it six days.* Jubilees plants the same glory on the same mountain, confirming that Enoch's theophany and Israel's Sinai are one event seen twice.
cards.s_text: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.
cards.t_text: And Moses went up into the mount of Elohim (God), and the glory of Yahuah (God) abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it six days.

cards.note: Jubilees 2:9 — *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years.* Jubilees spells out what Enoch's summer and winter imply — the appointed times, feasts, and sabbaths are fixed by the lights, not by men.
cards.s_text: Behold the summer and the winter, how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds and dew and rain lie upon it.
