cards.t_text: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said to him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”

cards.note: *And I said to him: "Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me."* (Jubilees 18:11). The restored witness keeps the staying word — *Lay not your hand upon the lad... you fear Yahuah... and have not withheld your son* — verse-for-verse with *Lay not thine hand upon the lad... for now I know that thou fearest Elohim (God), seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me* (Genesis 22:12).
cards.s_text: And he said, Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you any thing unto him: for now I know that you fearest Elohim (God), seeing you have not withheld your son, your only son from me.
cards.t_text: And I said to him: “Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me.”

cards.note: *And Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son* (Jubilees 18:12). The restored witness carries the substitution entire — *a single ram caught by his horns... offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son* — matching *a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son* (Genesis 22:13). The ram dies that the son may live.
cards.s_text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
cards.t_text: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.

cards.note: *And Abraham called that place "Yahuah (God) has seen," so that it is said "(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen": that is Mount Sion* (Jubilees 18:13). The restored witness names the mount outright — *that is Mount Sion* — binding *Abraham called the name of that place Yahuah Yireh (Jehovah-jireh)... In the mount of Yahuah (LORD) it shall be seen* (Genesis 22:14) to the holy hill of Yahuah's house: the mount of provision and the mount of His dwelling are one.
cards.s_text: And Abraham called the name of that place Yahuah Yireh (Jehovah-jireh): as it is said to this day, In the mount of Yahuah (LORD) it shall be seen.
cards.t_text: And Abraham called that place “Yahuah (God) has seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen”: that is Mount Sion.

cards.note: *And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you* (Jubilees 18:16). The restored witness keeps the seal — *Because you have obeyed My voice... you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you* — matching *because thou hast obeyed my voice* (Genesis 22:18). The blessing of the nations in the seed rests on the obedience proven faithful; the faith counted righteous is the faith that did what it was told.
cards.s_text: And in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because you have obeyed my voice.
cards.t_text: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you: Go in peace."

cards.note: *And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore."* (Jubilees 18:15). The restored witness keeps the oath entire — *By Myself have I sworn... in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore* — matching the sworn blessing of Genesis 22:16-17, the seed beyond number bound by Yahuah's own self.
cards.s_text: And said, By myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (LORD), for because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son:
cards.t_text: And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore. And your seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,

cards.note: *And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God)* (Jubilees 19:9). The restored witness makes the trial plain: the whole land was promised to Abraham and his seed, yet he *begged a place there to bury his dead* and *said not a single word* of complaint. This is the faith behind *I am a stranger and a sojourner with you* (Genesis 23:4) — the heir who owns nothing but a grave, and is named *the friend of Elohim*.
cards.s_text: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
cards.t_text: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God).

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver* (Jubilees 19:5). The restored witness keeps the purchase whole: Abraham besought the sons of Heth for *the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field... for a possession of a buryingplace* (Genesis 23:9), and received *the land of the double cave over against Mamre... for four hundred pieces of silver* — Machpelah meaning the double cave, the very price of Genesis 23:15-16.
cards.s_text: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.

cards.note: *And they besought him, saying, "We shall give it to you for nothing"; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave* (Jubilees 19:6). Ephron had said *the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee... bury thy dead* (Genesis 23:11), but Abraham *would not take it... for nothing* — *he gave the price of the place, the money in full*. The grave is bought outright, a true deed, not a gift to be reclaimed.
cards.s_text: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I you, and the cave that is therein, I give it you; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it you: bury your dead.
cards.t_text: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to you for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave.

cards.note: *And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron* (Jubilees 19:2). The restored witness keeps the death of Sarah at Hebron — *Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan* (Genesis 23:2) — *the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron*. The mother of the promised seed dies in the land sworn to that seed.
cards.s_text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
cards.t_text: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.

cards.note: *And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed* (Jubilees 19:3). The mourning of Genesis 23:2 — *Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her* — is read in the restored witness as a trial of faith: *Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her... and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed*. He grieves and trusts in the same breath.
cards.s_text: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
cards.t_text: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.

cards.note: *Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth. If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered* (Jubilees 19:21–22). The restored witness carries the same innumerable-seed blessing on the next carrier of the line — *his seed will fill the whole earth... If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered* — the very promise laid on the bride in *be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them* (Genesis 24:60), the seed beyond counting passed on through Rebekah's womb.
cards.s_text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, You are our sister, be you the mother of thousands of millions, and let your seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
cards.t_text: Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth.

cards.note: *And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers* (Jubilees 23:1). The restored witness keeps the same idiom as *Abraham gave up the ghost, and died... and was gathered to his people* (Genesis 25:8): he *slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers*. Death is not annihilation but a gathering-to-the-fathers — the patriarchal hope, the man laid up with his people to await the promise.
cards.s_text: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
cards.t_text: And he placed two fingers of Jacob on his eyes, and he blessed the Elohim (God) of gods, and he covered his face and stretched out his feet and slept the sleep of eternity, and was gathered to his fathers.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: "Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you."* (Jubilees 24:9). The restored witness keeps the word entire — *Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of* — matching *Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of* (Genesis 26:2). Where Abraham went down to Egypt in the first famine, Isaac is forbidden it; the son must stay in the land of the oath.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell you of:
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him and said to him: “Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land that I shall tell you of, and sojourn in this land, and I shall be with you and bless you.

cards.note: *For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land* (Jubilees 24:10). The restored witness carries the confirmation whole — *I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven* — matching *I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father; and I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven* (Genesis 26:3-4). The oath to the father is established to the son, the star-seed renewed.
cards.s_text: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you; for unto you, and unto your seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham your father;
cards.t_text: For to you and to your seed shall I give all this land, and I shall establish My oath which I sware to Abraham your father, and I shall multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and shall give to your seed all this land.

cards.note: *And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land* (Jubilees 24:11). The restored witness keeps the keystone fuller still — *your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant* — matching *Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws* (Genesis 26:5), and adds the charge to the son: *now obey My voice*. The covenant blessing rests on the obedience proven, and the son is called to the same keeping.
cards.s_text: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
cards.t_text: And in your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because your father obeyed My voice, and kept My charge and My commandments, and My laws, and My ordinances, and My covenant; and now obey My voice and dwell in this land.”

cards.note: *And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them* (Jubilees 24:18). The restored witness keeps it verse-for-verse — *they digged again the wells... which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham... he called their names as Abraham his father had named them* — matching Genesis 26:18. The son restores both the wells and the names; nothing of the fathers' way is lost, only re-opened where it was stopped.
cards.s_text: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
cards.t_text: And they digged again the wells of water which the servants of Abraham, his father, had digged, and which the Philistines had closed after the death of Abraham his father, and he called their names as Abraham his father had named them.

cards.note: *And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name "Enmity." And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it "Room," and Isaac said: "Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land."* (Jubilees 24:20). The restored witness carries the three wells whole — Perversity, Enmity, and at last *Room*, *Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us* — matching Esek, Sitnah, and *Rehoboth... For now Yahuah (LORD) hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land* (Genesis 26:22). Through strife the son holds to the fathers' digging until Yahuah makes room.
cards.s_text: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now Yahuah (LORD) has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
cards.t_text: And they dug a second well, and they strove for that also, and he called its name “Enmity.” And he arose from thence and they digged another well, and for that they strove not, and he called the name of it “Room,” and Isaac said: “Now Yahuah (God) has made room for us, and we have increased in the land.”

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) appeared to him that night, on the new moon of the first month, and said to him: "I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham your father; fear not, for I am with you, and shall bless you and shall surely multiply your seed as the sand of the earth, for the sake of Abraham my servant."* (Jubilees 24:22). The restored witness keeps the theophany entire — *I am the Elohim of Abraham your father; fear not, for I am with you... for the sake of Abraham my servant* — matching *I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake* (Genesis 26:24). The One who appeared to the father appears to the son and names Himself by the father's covenant.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham your father: fear not, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him that night, on the new moon of the first month, and said to him: “I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham your father; fear not, for I am with you, and shall bless you and shall surely multiply your seed as the sand of the earth, for the sake of Abraham my servant.”

cards.note: *And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father* (Jubilees 24:23). The restored witness deepens *he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Yahuah (LORD)* (Genesis 26:25): the altar was the one *Abraham his father had first built*. The son worships at the father's altar, calls on the same Name, offers to the same Elohim — the covenant-worship handed down unbroken from father to son.
cards.s_text: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Yahuah (LORD), and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.
cards.t_text: And he built an altar there, which Abraham his father had first built, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (God), and he offered sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father.

cards.note: *"The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau," and he discerned him not, because it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception and Isaac discerned not, for his hands were hairy as (his brother) Esau's, so that he blessed him* (Jubilees 26:18). The restored witness keeps the line whole — *The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau* (Genesis 27:22) — and names the cause outright: *it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception*. Heaven, not Rebekah's cunning, settled where the blessing fell.
cards.s_text: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
cards.t_text: “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau,” and he discerned him not, because it was a dispensation from heaven to remove his power of perception and Isaac discerned not, for his hands were hairy as (his brother) Esau’s, so that he blessed him.

cards.note: *"Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a (full) field which Yahuah (God) has blessed. And may Yahuah (God) give you of the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil: Let nations serve you, And peoples bow down to you."* (Jubilees 26:22–23). The restored witness keeps the blessing — *the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil* — matching *Therefore Elohim (God) give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine* (Genesis 27:28). The bounty of heaven and earth is poured on the chosen seed.
cards.s_text: Therefore Elohim (God) give you of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
cards.t_text: And may Yahuah (God) give you of the dew of heaven And of the dew of the earth, and plenty of corn and oil: Let nations serve you, And peoples bow down to you.

cards.note: *"Be lord over your brethren, And let your mother's sons bow down to you; And may all the blessings wherewith Yahuah (God) has blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father, Be imparted to you and to your seed for ever Cursed be he that curses you, And blessed be he that blesses you."* (Jubilees 26:24). The restored witness makes the inheritance explicit: the bless/curse formula of *cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee* (Genesis 27:29) is named as *all the blessings wherewith Yahuah has blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father... to you and to your seed for ever*. The Abrahamic seed-blessing is consciously handed down — Abraham to Isaac to Jacob to the seed for ever.
cards.s_text: Let people serve you, and nations bow down to you: be lord over your brethren, and let your mother’s sons bow down to you: cursed be every one that curses you, and blessed be he that blesses you.
cards.t_text: Be lord over your brethren, And let your mother’s sons bow down to you; And may all the blessings wherewith Yahuah (God) has blessed me and blessed Abraham, my father, Be imparted to you and to your seed for ever Cursed be he that curses you, And blessed be he that blesses you."

cards.note: *And Esau said to Isaac, his father: "Have you but one blessing, O father? Bless me, (even) me also, father": And Esau lifted up his voice and wept* (Jubilees 26:32). The restored witness keeps the cry and the tears whole — *Have you but one blessing, O father?... And Esau lifted up his voice and wept* — matching *Hast thou but one blessing, my father?... And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept* (Genesis 27:38). The bitter cry of the brother who despised the birthright is recorded in every witness.
cards.s_text: And Esau said unto his father, Have you but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
cards.t_text: And Esau said to Isaac, his father: “Have you but one blessing, O father? Bless me, (even) me also, father”: And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.

cards.note: *"And by your sword will you live, And you will serve your brother. And it shall come to pass when you become great, And do shake his yoke from off your neck, You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven."* (Jubilees 26:34). The restored witness keeps Esau's blessing — *by your sword will you live, And you will serve your brother... do shake his yoke from off your neck* — matching *by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and... thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck* (Genesis 27:40), and sharpens the warning: *You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven*. The doom rests on the rebellion, the system set against the covenant.
cards.s_text: And by your sword shall you live, and shall serve your brother; and it shall come to pass when you shall have the dominion, that you shall break his yoke from off your neck.
cards.t_text: And by your sword will you live, And you will serve your brother. And it shall come to pass when you become great, And do shake his yoke from off your neck, You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven.”

cards.note: *And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob."* (Jubilees 26:35). The restored witness keeps the murderous grudge whole — *Esau kept threatening Jacob... "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob"* — matching *Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing... The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob* (Genesis 27:41). The hatred over the blessing becomes a settled plot of fratricide.
cards.s_text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
cards.t_text: And Esau kept threatening Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him, and he said in his heart: “May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob.”

cards.note: *And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: "I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil."* (Jubilees 27:8). The restored witness gives Rebecca's plea behind the charge *Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan* (Genesis 28:1) — *the daughters of Canaan are evil* — the covenant mother grieved by Esau's marriages and resolved that Jacob shall not follow.
cards.s_text: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
cards.t_text: And Rebecca went in and said to Isaac: “I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken him as wives; and if Jacob take a wife from among the daughters of the land such as these, for what purpose do I further live; for the daughters of Canaan are evil.”

cards.note: *"Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother."* (Jubilees 27:10). The restored witness keeps Isaac's charge whole — *go to Mesopotamia... take you a wife of the daughters of Laban* — matching *Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother* (Genesis 28:2): the bride drawn from the covenant kindred, not the daughters of Canaan.
cards.s_text: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father; and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
cards.t_text: “Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan; arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother’s father, and take you a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

cards.note: *"And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham."* (Jubilees 27:11). The restored witness keeps Isaac's blessing entire — *El Shaddai bless you... give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings* — matching *And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless thee... And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land* (Genesis 28:3-4): the Abrahamic covenant explicitly handed to Jacob.
cards.s_text: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a multitude of people;
cards.t_text: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you and increase and multiply you that you may become a company of nations, and give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which Elohim (God) gave to Abraham: go, my son, in peace.”

cards.note: *And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it* (Jubilees 27:21). The restored witness keeps the vision verse-for-verse with *behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it* (Genesis 28:12) — the same ladder, the same ascending and descending host, the one stair joining earth to heaven.
cards.s_text: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending on it.
cards.t_text: And he dreamt that night, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it: and behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it.

cards.note: *And behold, Yahuah (God) stood upon it. And He spake to Jacob and said: "I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac; the land whereon you are sleeping, to you shall I give it, and to your-seed after you."* (Jubilees 27:21–22). The restored witness keeps the One atop the ladder who bears the Name — *Yahuah stood upon it... I am Yahuah Elohim of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim of Isaac* — matching *behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham thy father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac* (Genesis 28:13): the Formed Yahuah who appears and speaks, renewing the land to Jacob and his seed.
cards.s_text: And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) stood above it, and said, I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac: the land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your seed;
cards.t_text: And He spake to Jacob and said: “I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac; the land whereon you are sleeping, to you shall I give it, and to your-seed after you.

cards.note: *"And your seed will be as the dust of the earth, and you will increase to the west and to the east, to the north and the south, and in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed."* (Jubilees 27:23). The restored witness keeps the seed-promise whole — *your seed will be as the dust of the earth... in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed* — verse-for-verse with *And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth... and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed* (Genesis 28:14): the dust-numbered seed and the blessing of the families spoken over Jacob.
cards.s_text: And your seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and you shall spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in you and in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
cards.t_text: And your seed will be as the dust of the earth, and you will increase to the west and to the east, to the north and the south, and in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed.

cards.note: *And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, "Truly this place is the house of Yahuah (God), and I knew it not." And he was afraid and said: "Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven."* (Jubilees 27:25). The restored witness keeps Jacob's waking cry whole — *the house of Yahuah... none other than the house of Elohim, and this is the gate of heaven* — matching *Surely Yahuah (LORD) is in this place... this is none other but the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven* (Genesis 28:16-17).
cards.s_text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven.
cards.t_text: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, “Truly this place is the house of Yahuah (God), and I knew it not.” And he was afraid and said:" Dreadful is this place which is none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven."

cards.note: *And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God), saying: "If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and give me bread to eat and raiment to put on, so that I come again to my father's house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God), and this stone which I have set up as a pillar for a sign in this place, shall be Yahuah (God)'s house, and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God)."* (Jubilees 27:27). The restored witness keeps the vow entire — *If Yahuah will be with me... then shall Yahuah be my Elohim... and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you* — matching *And Jacob vowed a vow... If Elohim (God) will be with me... then shall Yahuah (LORD) be my Elohim (God)... and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee* (Genesis 28:20-22).
cards.s_text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If Elohim (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
cards.t_text: And Jacob vowed a vow to Yahuah (God), saying: “If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and give me bread to eat and raiment to put on, so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God), and this stone which I have set up as a pillar for a sign in this place, shall be Yahuah (God)’s house, and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you, my Elohim (God).”

cards.note: Jubilees 10:26 — *And Yahuah (God) sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name "Overthrow."* Jubilees records the same tower of strife overthrown and its builders judged that 3 Baruch 2:7 places in the first heaven.
cards.s_text: And he said to me, These are they who built the tower of strife against Elohim (God), and Yahuah (Lord) banished them.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name “Overthrow.”

cards.note: Jubilees 10:24 — *And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another's speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.* Jubilees records the same confounding of speech and ceasing of the work that 3 Baruch 3:8 describes.
cards.s_text: When Elohim (God) saw this He did not permit them, but smote them with blindness and confusion of speech, and rendered them as thou seest.
cards.t_text: And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another’s speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:20 — *And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which comes out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of Shinar.* Jubilees records the same brick-making in Shinar that 3 Baruch 3:5 says was driven on the multitudes by force.
cards.s_text: And he said, These are they who gave counsel to build the tower, for they whom thou seest drove forth multitudes of both men and women, to make bricks; among whom, a woman making bricks was not allowed to be released in the hour of child-birth, but brought forth while she was making bricks, and carried her child in her apron, and continued to make bricks.
cards.t_text: And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which comes out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of Shinar.

cards.note: *And Laban said to Jacob: "It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder." And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder* (Jubilees 28:6). The restored witness keeps Laban's rule — *it is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder* — and roots it in the heavenly tables, matching *It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn* (Genesis 29:26): the very order Jacob overturned for himself is the ordained order he is now made to keep.
cards.s_text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
cards.t_text: And Laban said to Jacob: “It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder.” And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder–but the elder one gives first and after her the younger–and the man who does so, they set down guilt against him in heaven, and none is righteous that does this thing, for this deed is evil before Yahuah (God).

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben... But the womb of Rachel was closed, for Yahuah (God) saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved* (Jubilees 28:11–12). The restored witness keeps the turn whole — *Yahuah opened the womb of Leah... for Yahuah saw that Leah was hated* — matching *when Yahuah (LORD) saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren* (Genesis 29:31). The unloved wife is the one Yahuah visits first; the foundation of the tribes is laid in her affliction.
cards.s_text: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week.

cards.note: *And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon* (Jubilees 28:13). The restored witness names the second son with Genesis 29:33 — *she conceived again, and bare a son... she called his name Simeon* — the tribal fathers come one after another from the hated wife's opened womb, each birth a stone laid in the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.s_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because Yahuah (LORD) has heard that I was hated, he has therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
cards.t_text: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon, on the twenty-first of the tenth month, and in the third year of this week.

cards.note: *And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi... And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Jubilees 28:14–15). The restored witness carries Levi and Judah together — the priestly tribe and the kingly tribe born back to back — matching *she called his name Levi* (Genesis 29:34) and *she called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Genesis 29:35). The two tribes that will carry the altar and the scepter come from the wife Yahuah remembered.
cards.s_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
cards.t_text: And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.

cards.note: *And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week* (Jubilees 28:15). The restored witness records the fourth son by name and day — *bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah)* — matching *Now will I praise Yahuah (LORD): therefore she called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Genesis 29:35). The tribe of the scepter and the praise is set down in the witness as the fourth-born of Leah.
cards.s_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise Yahuah (LORD): therefore she called his name Yahudah (Judah); and left bearing.
cards.t_text: And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.

cards.note: *And he went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a son, and he called his name Dan, on the ninth of the sixth month, in the sixth year of the third week* (Jubilees 28:18). The restored witness keeps the birth of the first maid-son with its very date — *bare him a son, and he called his name Dan* — matching *Elohim (God) hath judged me... and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan* (Genesis 30:6); the tribal roll begun and dated in the heavenly reckoning.
cards.s_text: And Rachel said, Elohim (God) has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
cards.t_text: (And she gave (him) Bilhah her handmaid to wife.) And he went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a son, and he called his name Dan, on the ninth of the sixth month, in the sixth year of the third week.

cards.note: *And Jacob went in again to Bilhah a second time, and she conceived, and bare Jacob another son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali, on the fifth of the seventh month, in the second year of the fourth week* (Jubilees 28:19). The restored witness carries the second of Bilhah's sons — *Rachel called his name Naphtali* — matching *she called his name Naphtali* (Genesis 30:8); another father of a tribe set in the dated roll.
cards.s_text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
cards.t_text: And Jacob went in again to Bilhah a second time, and she conceived, and bare Jacob another son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali, on the fifth of the seventh month, in the second year of the fourth week.

cards.note: *And he went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare him a second son, and Leah called his name Asher, on the second of the eleventh month, in the fifth year of the fourth week* (Jubilees 28:21). The restored witness keeps Zilpah's second son — *Leah called his name Asher* — matching *she called his name Asher* (Genesis 30:13); the eighth of the twelve fathers entered into the record.
cards.s_text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
cards.t_text: And he went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare him a second son, and Leah called his name Asher, on the second of the eleventh month, in the fifth year of the fourth week.

cards.note: *And Jacob went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare two (children), a son and a daughter, and she called the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah, in the seventh of the seventh month, in the sixth year of the fourth week* (Jubilees 28:23). The restored witness carries Zebulun and Dinah together — *the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah* — matching *she called his name Zebulun... and called her name Dinah* (Genesis 30:20-21); the last of Leah's children dated in the roll.
cards.s_text: And Leah said, Elohim (God) has endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
cards.t_text: And Jacob went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare two (children), a son and a daughter, and she called the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah, in the seventh of the seventh month, in the sixth year of the fourth week.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week* (Jubilees 28:24). The restored witness keeps the birth of the northern-house head — *Yahuah was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb... she called his name Joseph* — matching *Elohim (God) remembered Rachel... and she called his name Joseph* (Genesis 30:22,24); the twelfth-born son who heads the scattered house that shall be gathered.
cards.s_text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, Yahuah (LORD) shall add to me another son.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week.

cards.note: *And all the sheep brought forth spotted and speckled and black, variously marked, and they brought forth again lambs like themselves, and all that were spotted were Jacob's and those which were not were Laban's* (Jubilees 28:28). The restored witness keeps the wages-arrangement — *all that were spotted were Jacob's* — matching *removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle... and of such shall be my hire* (Genesis 30:32); the flock yielding to Jacob exactly the marked beasts he had named.
cards.s_text: I will pass through all your flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
cards.t_text: And all the sheep brought forth spotted and speckled and black, variously marked, and they brought forth again lambs like themselves, and all that were spotted were Jacob’s and those which were not were Laban’s.

cards.note: *And Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants. And Laban and his sons envied Jacob, and Laban took back his sheep from him, and he observed him with evil intent* (Jubilees 28:29–30). The restored witness carries the increase whole — *Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly* — matching *the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses* (Genesis 30:43); and it names what follows, Laban's envy, the strife of ch31 already gathering.
cards.s_text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
cards.t_text: And Jacob’s possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants.

cards.note: *And Jacob blessed the Elohim (God) of Isaac his father, and the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father's father, and he arose and mounted his wives and his children, and took all his possessions and crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead, and Jacob hid his intention from Laban and told him not* (Jubilees 29:4). The restored witness carries the obedience to *Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred* (Genesis 31:3) — Jacob *crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead*, setting his face homeward as he was bidden, blessing the Elohim of his fathers as he goes.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of your fathers, and to your kindred; and I will be with you.
cards.t_text: And Jacob blessed the Elohim (God) of Isaac his father, and the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father’s father, and he arose and mounted his wives and his children, and took all his possessions and crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead, and Jacob hid his intention from Laban and told him not.

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night* (Jubilees 29:6). The restored witness names the guard plainly — *Yahuah did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night* — the same shielding of *Elohim (God) suffered him not to hurt me* (Genesis 31:7) and *Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob* (Genesis 31:24): the adversary restrained by the dream, the seed-bearer kept.
cards.s_text: And your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but Elohim (God) suffered him not to hurt me.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night. And Laban spake to Jacob,

cards.note: *And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: "The Heap of Witness," after this heap* (Jubilees 29:8). The restored witness names the heap exactly as *This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed* (Genesis 31:48) — *he made there a heap for a witness... "The Heap of Witness."* The piled stones stand as the silent testimony of the covenant sworn between the parted parties.
cards.s_text: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
cards.t_text: And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: “The Heap of Witness,” after this heap.

cards.note: *And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents* (Jubilees 29:13). The restored witness keeps the parting — *departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents* — matching *So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir* (Genesis 33:16): the peace is real, but the paths divide; Esau goes up to Edom, and the covenant-bearer pitches his tents toward the land of promise.
cards.s_text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
cards.t_text: And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.

cards.note: *And Jacob sent away Laban, and he departed into Mesopotamia, the land of the East, and Jacob returned to the land of Gilead... And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents* (Jubilees 29:12–13). The restored witness names the meeting outright — *Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him* — the dread of the four hundred men of Genesis 33:1 turned to the embrace of *Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck* (Genesis 33:4).
cards.s_text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
cards.t_text: And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.

cards.note: *And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years* (Jubilees 30:2). The restored witness keeps the defilement entire — *he lay with her and defiled her* — matching *Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her* (Genesis 34:2), and adds the weight of her youth, a child carried off. The holy seed-line of Jacob is violated by the prince of the nations.
cards.s_text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
cards.t_text: And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.

cards.note: *And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar'el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 30:5). The restored witness echoes the very charge of *he had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done* (Genesis 34:7) — *they had wrought shame in Yashar'el*. The defiling of a daughter of the covenant is no private wrong but a shame against the whole set-apart people.
cards.s_text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
cards.t_text: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar’el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar’el (Israel).

cards.note: *And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah (God). For this reason I have written for you in the words of the Law all the deeds of the Shechemites, which they wrought against Dinah, and how the sons of Jacob spake, saying: "We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us."* (Jubilees 30:11–12). The restored witness quotes the sons' own answer back — *We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us* — the very words of *We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us* (Genesis 34:14). The covenant-sign that marks the seed is here turned into the terms of a snare.
cards.s_text: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
cards.t_text: For this reason I have written for you in the words of the Law all the deeds of the Shechemites, which they wrought against Dinah, and how the sons of Jacob spake, saying: “We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us.”

cards.note: *And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah* (Jubilees 30:4). The restored witness names the two brothers and the motive — *slew all the men... because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah* — matching *Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword... and slew all the males* (Genesis 34:25). The provocation was real defilement; the answer was wrath without restraint, the very anger the curse of Genesis 49 traces home.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
cards.t_text: And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah.

cards.note: *And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 30:11). Hamor's offer — *make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you* (Genesis 34:9) — is the very thing the restored witness reads the chapter to forbid: *not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations*. The seed is to be kept distinct, not merged into "one people" with the land.
cards.s_text: And make you marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
cards.t_text: And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah (God).

cards.note: *And it is a reproach to Yashar'el (Israel), to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the nations; for this is unclean and abominable to Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 30:13). The proposal to *become one people* (Genesis 34:16) by giving and taking daughters is named a reproach both ways — *to those who give, and to those who take* — the seed-line guarded from mingling with the nations. The set-apart people is not to dissolve into the land that defiled its daughter.
cards.s_text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
cards.t_text: And it is a reproach to Yashar’el (Israel), to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the nations; for this is unclean and abominable to Yashar’el (Israel).

cards.note: *And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 30:18). The restored witness re-weighs the Levite who drew the sword in *Simeon and Levi... took each man his sword* (Genesis 34:25): what is reckoned is not the slaughter but the zeal — *zealous to execute righteousness and judgment* — and the scattering Jacob cursed is providentially turned into the priesthood distributed through Yashar'el. The honour is on the refusal to let the holy seed be defiled, not on the bloodshed.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
cards.t_text: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar’el (Israel).

cards.note: *And on the day when the sons of Jacob slew Shechem a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness and uprightness and vengeance on the sinners, and it was written for a blessing* (Jubilees 30:23). The restored witness reads the day of *the sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister* (Genesis 34:27) as zeal for the holiness of the seed — *executed righteousness and uprightness... on the sinners*. This stands in tension with the deathbed curse of Genesis 49:7; the framework holds both — the bloodshed is judged, yet the zeal-against-defilement is what the witness presses — without glorifying the sword.
cards.s_text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
cards.t_text: And on the day when the sons of Jacob slew Shechem a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness and uprightness and vengeance on the sinners, and it was written for a blessing.

cards.note: *And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: "Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put you away the strange gods that are among you."* (Jubilees 31:1). The restored witness keeps the command whole — *Purify yourselves and change your garments... put you away the strange gods that are among you* — matching *Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments* (Genesis 35:2), and binds it to the vow now to be paid.
cards.s_text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
cards.t_text: And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: “Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put you away the strange gods that are among you.”

cards.note: *And they gave up the strange gods and that which was in their ears and which was on their necks, and the idols which Rachel stole from Laban her brother she gave wholly to Jacob. And he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem* (Jubilees 31:2). The restored witness names what Genesis holds — *they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods... and all their earrings... and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem* (Genesis 35:4) — and tells plainly that *the idols which Rachel stole from Laban* were among them, burnt and broken before they are buried.
cards.s_text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
cards.t_text: And they gave up the strange gods and that which was in their ears and which was on their necks, and the idols which Rachel stole from Laban her brother she gave wholly to Jacob. And he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem.

cards.note: *And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: "Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace..."* (Jubilees 31:1). The restored witness names the reason for the going up — *to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled* — the same vow-keeping behind *Arise, go up to Beth-el... make there an altar... that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau* (Genesis 35:1).
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto Elohim (God), that appeared unto you when you fleddest from the face of Esau your brother.
cards.t_text: And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: “Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put you away the strange gods that are among you.”

cards.note: *And Yahuah (God) appeared to him by night and blessed him and said to him: "Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall they name your name."* (Jubilees 32:17). The restored witness keeps the reaffirmation entire — *Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar'el shall they name your name* — matching *Thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall be thy name* (Genesis 35:10), the wrestling-name confirmed straight from Yahuah's mouth.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said unto him, Your name is Jacob: your name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall be your name: and he called his name Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him by night and blessed him and said to him: “Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar’el (Israel) shall they name your name.”

cards.note: *And He said to him again: "I am Yahuah (God) who created the heaven and the earth, and I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you, and they will judge everywhere wherever the foot of the sons of men has trodden."* (Jubilees 32:18). The restored witness keeps the El-Shaddai covenant — *I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you* — alongside *I am El Shaddai... be fruitful and multiply... and kings shall come out of thy loins* (Genesis 35:11), and *the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it* (Genesis 35:12), the seed and the land sworn together.
cards.s_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to you I will give it, and to your seed after you will I give the land.
cards.t_text: And He said to him again: “I am Yahuah (God) who created the heaven and the earth, and I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you, and they will judge everywhere wherever the foot of the sons of men has trodden.

cards.note: *I shall give to your seed all the earth which is under heaven, and they will judge all the nations according to their desires, and after that they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.”* (Jubilees 32:19). *And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.* (Genesis 35:12). At Bethel the promise to Jacob in Genesis is the land, the land given to Abraham and Isaac, now given to him and to his seed after him. Jubilees records the same promise at the same place and lets it run to its full length: all the earth which is under heaven, the nations judged by his seed, and the whole earth possessed and inherited for ever. The land promised to the fathers was never the ceiling. It was the first instalment of an inheritance that widens to the whole earth, held by the seed of Jacob gathered home, and both books are describing the one promise at its two ends.
cards.s_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to you I will give it, and to your seed after you will I give the land.
cards.t_text: Ana I shall give to your seed all the earth which is under heaven, and they will judge all the nations according to their desires, and after that they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.”

cards.note: *And Rachel bare a son in the night, and called his name "Son of my sorrow"; for she suffered in giving him birth: but his father called his name Benjamin, on the eleventh of the eighth month in the first of the sixth week of this jubilee* (Jubilees 32:33). The restored witness keeps both names — *"Son of my sorrow"... but his father called his name Benjamin* — matching *as her soul was in departing... she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin* (Genesis 35:18): the dying mother's sorrow turned by the father into the son of the right hand.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.
cards.t_text: And Rachel bare a son in the night, and called his name “Son of my sorrow”; for she suffered in giving him birth: but his father called his name Benjamin, on the eleventh of the eighth month in the first of the sixth week of this jubilee.

cards.note: *And to Yahudah (Judah) he said: May Yahuah (God) give you strength and power To tread down all that hate you; A prince shall you be, you and one of your sons, over the sons of Jacob... In you shall be the help of Jacob, And in you be found the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 31:18–19). Among the twelve sons numbered at Bethel — *the sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah)* (Genesis 35:23) — the kingly office falls to Yahudah, and the restored witness sings it: *A prince shall you be... In you be found the salvation of Yashar'el*. The sceptre that goes to Judah carries the seed-promise toward the King to come.
cards.s_text: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah), and Issachar, and Zebulun:
cards.t_text: And to Yahudah (Judah) he said: May Yahuah (God) give you strength and power To tread down all that hate you; A prince shall you be, you and one of your sons, over the sons of Jacob; May your name and the name of your sons go forth and traverse every land and region. Then will the nations fear before your face, And all the nations will quake And all the peoples will quake.

cards.note: *And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him: "May the Elohim (God) of all... bless you and your children throughout all the ages... and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones."* (Jubilees 31:13–14). Of the twelve sons (Genesis 35:23), the priesthood falls to Levi, and the restored witness gives Isaac's blessing upon him — *to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary*. The tribe set apart to draw near is marked here at Bethel, the priestly office settled among the sons of Jacob.
cards.s_text: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah), and Issachar, and Zebulun:
cards.t_text: And may Yahuah (God) give to you and to your seed greatness and great glory, and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones. (Even) as they, will the seed of your sons be for glory and greatness and holiness, and may He make them great to all the ages.

cards.note: *And the sons of Edom have not got quit of the yoke of servitude which the twelve sons of Jacob had imposed on them until this day. And these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar'el (Israel) until this day in the land of Edom* (Jubilees 38:14–15). The restored witness keeps the same formula verbatim — *these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar'el* — matching Genesis 36:31, and frames it under the servitude of Edom to the twelve sons of Jacob: the adversary-house subdued, the covenant line awaiting its own crown.
cards.s_text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar’el (Israel) until this day in the land of Edom.

cards.note: *And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh... And the sons of Jacob slaughtered a kid, and dipped the coat of Joseph in the blood, and sent (it) to Jacob their father* (Jubilees 34:11–12). The restored witness carries the counsel of *Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites... for he is our brother and our flesh* (Genesis 37:27): the plot to slay turned to a sale, *they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt* — the brother sold rather than slain.
cards.s_text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
cards.t_text: And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the cooks, priest of the city of ’Êlêw.

cards.note: *And he mourned for Joseph one year, and did not cease, for he said "Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son."* (Jubilees 34:17). The restored witness keeps the father's grief — *Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son* — matching *I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning* (Genesis 37:35): the father refuses comfort, the son reckoned among the dead and gone down to sheol, the deepest point of the descent before the raising.
cards.s_text: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
cards.t_text: And he mourned for Joseph one year, and did not cease, for he said “Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son.”

cards.note: *For this reason it is ordained for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they should afflict themselves on the tenth of the seventh month... that they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat on the tenth of the seventh month, once a year, for their sins; for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph his son* (Jubilees 34:18). The restored witness binds the goat of *they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood* (Genesis 37:31) to the very origin of the Day of Atonement: the goat slain to cover the brothers' deceit becomes the *young goat* of the tenth of the seventh month, the affliction of souls for sin.
cards.s_text: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
cards.t_text: For this reason it is ordained for the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that they should afflict themselves on the tenth of the seventh month–on the day that the news which made him weep for Joseph came to Jacob his father–that they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat on the tenth of the seventh month, once a year, for their sins; for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph his son.

cards.note: *And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother's only, and he went into the house of his brother's wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah (God), and He slew him* (Jubilees 41:5). The restored witness keeps Onan's sin verse-for-verse with *Onan knew that the seed should not be his... he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother... and the thing which he did displeased Yahuah (LORD): wherefore he slew him also* (Genesis 38:9-10) — the refusal of the brother's seed counted wicked in the eyes of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
cards.t_text: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother’s only, and he went into the house of his brother’s wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah (God), and He slew him.

cards.note: *And Yahudah (Judah) said to Onan, his brother: "Go in to your brother's wife and perform the duty of a husband's brother to her, and raise up seed to your brother."* (Jubilees 41:4). The restored witness carries the levirate charge whole — *perform the duty of a husband's brother... and raise up seed to your brother* — matching *Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother* (Genesis 38:8): the covenant duty laid plainly upon Onan to preserve his brother's seed.
cards.s_text: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto Onan, Go in unto your brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to your brother.
cards.t_text: And Yahudah (Judah) said to Onan, his brother: “Go in to your brother’s wife and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up seed to your brother.”

cards.note: *And she said to him: "Give me my hire"; and he said to her: "I have nothing in my hand save my ring that is on my finger, and my necklace, and my staff which is in my hand."... and he gave them to her, (and he went in to her,) and she conceived by him* (Jubilees 41:11–12). The restored witness keeps the pledge entire — *my ring... my necklace... my staff* given for the hire — matching *Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him* (Genesis 38:18). The tokens handed over in the dark will become the very witnesses that convict and acquit.
cards.s_text: And he said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, Your signet, and your bracelets, and your staff that is in your hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
cards.t_text: And she said to him: “Give me my hire”; and he said to her: “I have nothing in my hand save my ring that is on my finger, and my necklace, and my staff which is in my hand.”

cards.note: *And she put off her widow's clothes, and put on a veil, and adorned herself, and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah* (Jubilees 41:9). The restored witness carries Tamar's act whole — *put off her widow's clothes... put on a veil... sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah* — matching *she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath* (Genesis 38:14): withheld from her levirate right, she takes the only road left to raise up seed in Judah's house.
cards.s_text: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
cards.t_text: And she put off her widow’s clothes, and put on a veil, and adorned herself, and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah.

cards.note: *And it came to pass when they brought her forth to bum her that she sent to her father-in-law the ring and the necklace, and the staff, saying: "Discern whose are these, for by him am I with child."* (Jubilees 41:18).
