*by your sword will you live... You will sin a complete sin to death, And your seed will be rooted out from under heaven* (Jubilees 26:34) — the restored witness keeps Esau's sword-blessing of 27:40 and sharpens the doom on the rebellion.

*Esau kept threatening Jacob... "May the days of mourning for my father now come, so that I may slay my brother Jacob"* (Jubilees 26:34) — the restored witness keeps the murderous grudge of *then will I slay my brother Jacob* (27:41) whole; the seed-war enmity between brothers.
*I loathe my life because of the two daughters of Heth, whom Esau has taken... the daughters of Canaan are evil* (Jubilees 27:8) — the covenant mother's grief behind the charge of 28:1.

*Do not take you a wife of any of the daughters of Canaan... take you a wife of the daughters of Laban* (Jubilees 27:10) — Isaac's charge of 28:2 kept whole; the bride drawn from the covenant kindred.

*El Shaddai (God Almighty) bless you... give you the blessings of my father Abraham, to you and to your seed after you, that you may inherit the land of your sojournings* (Jubilees 27:11) — Isaac's blessing of 28:3-4 kept entire; the covenant explicitly handed to Jacob.

*a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and behold, the angels of Yahuah (God) ascended and descended on it* (Jubilees 27:21) — the vision of 28:12 kept verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

*Yahuah (God) stood upon it... I am Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham, your father, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac* (Jubilees 27:21) — the One atop the ladder who bears the Name (28:13) in the restored witness.
*your seed will be as the dust of the earth... in you and in your seed will all the families of the nations be blessed* (Jubilees 27:23) — the seed-promise of 28:14 kept verse-for-verse.
*Truly this place is the house of Yahuah (God)... none other than the house of Elohim (God), and this is the gate of heaven* (Jubilees 27:25) — Jacob's waking cry of 28:16-17 kept whole.

*If Yahuah (God) will be with me, and will keep me... then shall Yahuah (God) be my Elohim (God)... and of all that you give me, I shall give the tenth to you* (Jubilees 27:26) — the vow of 28:20-22 kept entire in the restored witness.

Jubilees 10:26 — *And Yahuah (God) sent a mighty wind against the tower and overthrew it upon the earth, and behold it was between Asshur and Babylon in the land of Shinar, and they called its name "Overthrow."* Jubilees records the same tower of strife overthrown and its builders judged that 3 Baruch 2:7 places in the first heaven.

Jubilees 10:20 — *And they began to build, and in the fourth week they made brick with fire, and the bricks served them for stone, and the clay with which they cemented them together was asphalt which comes out of the sea, and out of the fountains of water in the land of Shinar.* Jubilees records the same brick-making in Shinar that 3 Baruch 3:5 says was driven on the multitudes by force.

Jubilees 10:24 — *And He confounded their language, and they no longer understood one another's speech, and they ceased then to build the city and the tower.* Jubilees records the same confounding of speech and ceasing of the work that 3 Baruch 3:8 describes.

*It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder... thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables* (Jubilees 28:6) — the restored witness roots Laban's rule (29:26) in the heavenly order Jacob overturned.

*Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah... and he called his name Reuben... for Yahuah (God) saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved* (Jubilees 28:11) — the restored witness keeps the turn of 29:31: the hated wife visited first.
*she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon* (Jubilees 28:13) — the second tribal father, with 29:33; the house of Yashar'el built one birth at a time.

*she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi... and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah)* (Jubilees 28:14) — the priestly and kingly tribes born back to back, with 29:34.

*she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month* (Jubilees 28:14) — the restored witness sets the scepter-tribe down by name and day, with 29:35.
*bare him a son, and he called his name Dan* (Jubilees 28:18) — the first maid-son of 30:6 entered in the dated tribal roll.
*Rachel called his name Naphtali* (Jubilees 28:19) — the second of Bilhah's sons (30:8) in the roll.
*Leah called his name Asher* (Jubilees 28:21) — Zilpah's second son (30:13), the eighth father in the dated record.
*the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah* (Jubilees 28:23) — Zebulun and Dinah of 30:20-21 carried together in the roll.
*Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb... she called his name Joseph* (Jubilees 28:24) — the birth of the northern-house head (30:22,24) in the dated roll.
*all that were spotted were Jacob's and those which were not were Laban's* (Jubilees 28:28) — the wages-arrangement of 30:32 yielding Jacob exactly the marked beasts.
*Jacob's possessions multiplied exceedingly* (Jubilees 28:29) — the increase of 30:43 kept whole, with Laban's envy already gathering toward ch31.
*he... crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead* (Jubilees 29:4) — the obedience to *Return unto the land of thy fathers* (31:3) in the restored witness; Jacob sets his face homeward.

*Yahuah (God) did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night* (Jubilees 29:6) — the guard of 31:7,24 named plainly in the restored witness: the adversary restrained by the dream.

★ *he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: "The Heap of Witness"* (Jubilees 29:8) — the heap of *This heap is a witness between me and thee... called Galeed* (31:48) named in the restored witness.
*Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him* (Jubilees 29:11) — the dread of the four hundred men (33:1) turned to the embrace of 33:4 in the restored witness.

*he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents* (Jubilees 29:11) — the parting of 33:16: Esau up to Edom, the covenant-bearer toward the land of promise.

*there they carried off Dinah... and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years* (Jubilees 30:2) — the defilement of 34:2 kept entire, with the weight of her youth.
*because they had wrought shame in Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 30:5) — echoes the charge *he had wrought folly in Yashar'el... which thing ought not to be done* (34:7).
*We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us* (Jubilees 30:11) — the sons' own snare-words of 34:14 quoted back into the Law.

*Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem... and slew all the men whom they found in it... because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah* (Jubilees 30:4) — names the brothers and the real provocation behind 34:25; wrath without restraint.

*not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations* (Jubilees 30:11) — the Law the chapter testifies, against Hamor's *give your daughters... take our daughters* (34:9).
*it is a reproach to Yashar'el (Israel), to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the nations* (Jubilees 30:13) — the proposed *become one people* (34:16) named a reproach both ways.

*the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood... for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment* (Jubilees 30:18) — re-weighs the Levite of 34:25: the zeal reckoned, not the slaughter; scattering turned to priesthood.

*a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness... on the sinners* (Jubilees 30:23) — the day of 34:27 read as zeal-against-defilement; held in tension with the curse of Genesis 49:7, the sword not glorified.
*Purify yourselves and change your garments... put you away the strange gods that are among you* (Jubilees 31:1) — the command of 35:2 kept whole in the restored witness, bound to the vow.

*the idols which Rachel stole from Laban... he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem* (Jubilees 31:2) — names plainly what 35:4 buries.
*let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau* (Jubilees 31:1) — names the vow behind the call of 35:1.
*Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel) shall they name your name* (Jubilees 32:17) — the reaffirmation of 35:10 in the restored witness.
*I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you* (Jubilees 32:18) — the El-Shaddai covenant of 35:11 kept in the restored witness.
Jubilees 32:19 — *they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.* The land of Genesis 35:12 widened to the whole earth for Jacob's seed.
*she... called his name "Son of my sorrow"... but his father called his name Benjamin* (Jubilees 32:33) — both names of 35:18 kept; sorrow turned to the son of the right hand.
*A prince shall you be... In you be found the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 31:18) — the kingly office to Yahudah among the twelve (35:23); the sceptre toward the King to come.
*cause you and your seed... to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary* (Jubilees 31:13) — the priesthood to Levi among the twelve (35:23); the tribe set apart to draw near.

*these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 38:14) — the restored witness keeps the formula of 36:31 verbatim, under Edom's servitude to the twelve sons of Jacob.
*they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt* (Jubilees 34:11) — the counsel to sell of 37:27, the brother sold rather than slain.
*Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son* (Jubilees 34:16) — the father's grief of 37:35, the son reckoned among the dead in sheol.

*they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat... for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph* (Jubilees 34:18) — the goat of 37:31 bound to the origin of the Day of Atonement.
*Go in to your brother's wife and perform the duty of a husband's brother... and raise up seed to your brother* (Jubilees 41:4) — the levirate charge of 38:8 carried whole in the restored witness.

*he... spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah (God), and He slew him* (Jubilees 41:5) — Onan's sin of 38:9-10 verse-for-verse: the refusal of the brother's seed counted wicked.
*she put off her widow's clothes, and put on a veil... and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah* (Jubilees 41:9) — Tamar's act of 38:14 carried whole in the restored witness.
*my ring... and my necklace, and my staff... and he gave them to her... and she conceived by him* (Jubilees 41:11) — the pledge of 38:18: the tokens that will convict and redeem.
*she sent... the ring and the necklace, and the staff, saying: "Discern whose are these, for by him am I with child"* (Jubilees 41:18) — Tamar's appeal of 38:25; the pledge brought to light.
*"Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not."* (Jubilees 41:19) — Judah's confession of 38:26 verse-for-verse; the withheld levirate right was his fault.

★ *Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged that the deed... was evil... and he began to lament and to supplicate before Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 41:23) — the repentance behind *more righteous than I* (38:26); the seed kept through a man broken and turned.
*she bare two sons, Perez and Zerah* (Jubilees 41:21) — the twins of 38:27,29-30 named in the restored witness; the line of Judah established.
*he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did* (Jubilees 39:4) — the master's seeing of 39:3 kept verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

*he remembered Yahuah (God) and the words... that no man should commit fornication with a woman who has a husband... the sin will be recorded... before Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 39:6) — the Torah-weight behind *sin against Elohim* (39:9); the remembered word of the fathers stayed his hand.
*he left his garment in her hands and broke through the door and fled* (Jubilees 39:9) — the flight of 39:12 kept entire; held fast and the doors shut, he leaves the garment and breaks out.

*cast Joseph into prison... and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour... for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him* (Jubilees 39:11) — the casting-in of 39:20 with the mercy already turning toward him: lowered, but never abandoned.

*Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards... for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him* (Jubilees 39:11) — the prison-favour of 39:21 kept entire; the with-him presence prospers him even among the bound.

*they both dreamed a dream, the chief butler and the chief baker, and they told it to Joseph* (Jubilees 39:16) — the dream brought to the one who confesses the gift is God's (40:8); the dreamers hand their trouble to the slave, the slave to the Most High.

*as he interpreted to them so it befell them... Pharaoh restored the chief butler... and the (chief) baker he slew* (Jubilees 39:17) — the two interpretations of 40:12-19 fulfilled exactly; the word stood because the interpretation was Elohim's.

★ *the chief butler forgot Joseph in the prison, although he had informed him what would befall him... for he forgot* (Jubilees 39:18) — the wound of 40:23 kept entire; the righteous one left in the pit by the man he helped.

*then the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king, and he brought him forth from the prison* (Jubilees 40:2) — the other half of 40:23: the vindication only deferred, not lost; it waits Yahuah's appointed hour.

*Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine... and they were not able to declare them* (Jubilees 40:1) — the doubled dream and failed interpreters of 41:8 kept whole in the restored witness.

*We shall not find such a wise and discreet man as this man, for the spirit of Yahuah (God) is with him* (Jubilees 40:5) — Pharaoh's wonder of 41:38 kept whole; the Spirit upon the lowered one the throne cannot help but see.
*the second chariot... byssus garments... a gold chain upon his neck... a ring on his hand... ruler over all his house* (Jubilees 40:6) — the regalia of 41:42 kept entire in the restored witness.
*he recognized them, but they did not recognize him... "Are you not spies?"... And he put them in ward* (Jubilees 42:5) — the unrecognized rejected one of 42:8 kept whole in the restored witness.
*he sent his ten sons... but Benjamin he did not send* (Jubilees 42:4) — the sending of 42:3-4 kept plain; the ten go down, the youngest kept back.

*detained Simeon alone... filled their sacks with corn, and he put their gold in their sacks, and they did not know* (Jubilees 42:6) — Simeon bound (42:24) and the money secretly restored (42:25), kept whole.
*Send him with me, and if I do not bring him back to you, let me bear the blame* (Jubilees 42:19) — Judah's pledge of 43:8 kept whole; the royal tribe steps forward after Reuben's offer fails.
*Me have you bereaved of my children! Joseph is not and Simeon also is not, and you will take Benjamin away* (Jubilees 42:10) — the grief behind *If I be bereaved... I am bereaved* (43:14) laid bare.
*the portion of Benjamin was seven times larger than that of any of theirs* (Jubilees 42:23) — the favoured portion of 43:34 (the witness tells the measure as seven; quoted as given).
*put the cup in Benjamin's sack* (Jubilees 43:1) — the planting of the silver cup of 44:2 kept whole in the restored witness; the snare laid to test the brothers' hearts.
*let him be slain, and we... will serve your lord* (Jubilees 43:5) — the brothers' rash death-oath of 44:9 kept whole; the sentence they do not yet know will fall on Benjamin.
★ *let your servant... speak a word in my lord's ear* (Jubilees 43:11) — Judah's drawing-near of 44:18 kept whole; the one who once sold his brother now pleads for one.

*What shall we say and how shall we defend ourselves? Our lord has discovered the transgression of his servants* (Jubilees 43:9) — the brothers' confession of 44:16; the old guilt for Joseph surfacing as judgment overtakes them.

*his life also is bound up with the life of this (lad)... when... the lad is not with us, that he will die* (Jubilees 43:11) — the father's knit soul of 44:30 kept word-for-word in the restored witness.
*let me, your servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman to my lord... for I became surety for him* (Jubilees 43:13) — the self-substitution of 44:33 kept word-for-word in the restored witness.
*he could not refrain himself, and he told them that he was Joseph* (Jubilees 43:14) — the breaking-open of 45:1,4 kept whole in the restored witness.
*Yahuah (God) sent me before you... that many people might live* (Jubilees 43:18) — the providence-word of 45:5 kept whole in the restored witness.
*he... fell on their neck and wept* (Jubilees 43:15) — the falling-on-the-neck of 45:14-15 kept whole in the restored witness.
*the life of his spirit revived... It is enough for me if Joseph lives* (Jubilees 43:24) — the reviving of 45:27-28 kept whole in the restored witness.
*"Jacob, Jacob"... fear not to go down into Egypt, for I will there make of you a great nation* (Jubilees 44:5) — the Beer-sheba theophany of 46:2-3 kept whole in the restored witness.
*I shall go down with you, and I shall bring you up... and Joseph will put his hands upon your eyes* (Jubilees 44:6) — the bringing-up promise and the son's hand on the eyes of 46:4 kept entire.
*all the souls of Jacob which went into Egypt were seventy souls... in all seventy* (Jubilees 44:33) — the seventy-soul seed of 46:27 named again in the restored witness.
*sent Yahudah (Judah) before him to his son Joseph to examine the Land of Goshen* (Jubilees 44:9) — Judah sent before in 46:28, kept in the restored witness; the scepter-tribe readies the dwelling.

Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon—now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* The lunar shortfall against the solar year that Enoch measures is the drift Jubilees warns will disturb the appointed seasons.

Jubilees 2:2 — *For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before Him–the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels of the spirit of fire...* Jubilees lists the very hosts 2 Enoch sees imaged from fire, all created on the first day.

Jubilees 2:1 — *...how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.* Jubilees seals the same seventh-day Sabbath 2 Enoch blesses, hallowed for all ages as a sign.

Jubilees 5:4 — *And He said: “I shall destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which I have created.”* The sentence 2 Enoch 34:2 records, to bring the deluge and destroy all men, is the same word Jubilees preserves over the corrupt generation.

Jubilees 7:3 — *And he celebrated with joy the day of this feast, and he made a burnt sacrifice to Yahuah (God), one young ox and one ram, and seven sheep, each a year old, and a kid of the goats, that he might make atonement thereby for himself and his sons.* The sacrificial oxen offered before His face in 2 Enoch 68:7 are the same patriarchal burnt offering Noah, of Enoch's house, makes upon the altar in Jubilees.
*dwelt in the land of Goshen, the best part of the land of Egypt* (Jubilees 45:6) — the settling of 47:27 kept whole, with the pilgrimage-age 130 in the same breath.
*blessed them and gave to Joseph two portions in the land* (Jubilees 45:13) — the double portion of 48:5 kept whole in the restored witness: two sons made two tribes.
*true is the vision which I saw at Bethel. Blessed be Yahuah my Elohim (the LORD my God) for ever* (Jubilees 45:4) — the deathbed recital of the Bethel/Luz vision (48:3) kept in the restored witness.

*made known to them what would come upon them in the last days... and gave to Joseph two portions* (Jubilees 45:13) — the death-bed last-days frame of 49:1 with the double-portion to the northern house.
*carry his bones with them when they went forth from the land of Egypt* (Jubilees 46:5) — the restored witness keeps Joseph's last charge of 50:25 whole: the going-forth foreseen.
*buried in the double cave in the land of Canaan, near Abraham his father* (Jubilees 45:15) — the restored witness keeps the Machpelah burial of 50:13; the fathers gathered to the one purchased plot.

*the angels of Elohim (God)... took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants* (Jubilees 5:1) — the same days of Noah, the same disobedient angels (1 Peter 3:20).
*He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound* (Jubilees 5:6) — the fallen angels bound in the depths, the prison of 1 Peter 3:19.
*bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation* (Jubilees 5:10) — held until judgement, the disobedient spirits of the days of Noah (1 Peter 3:20).

Jubilees 5:6 — *He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound* the Watchers bound; *delivered them into chains of darkness* (2 Peter 2:4). Self-link to the live Jubilees Watchers record.
Jubilees 5:10 — *bound in the depths of the earth for ever, until the day of the great condemnation* the two-stage sentence; *to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4).
Jubilees 5:24 — *opened seven flood-gates of heaven, And the mouths of the fountains of the great deep.* The world Peter says *being overflowed with water, perished* (2 Peter 3:6).

Jubilees 4:2 — *Cain slew Abel because Elohim (God) accepted the sacrifice of Abel, and did not accept the offering of Cain* the rejected offering, the evil works; *Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous* (1 John 3:12).
Jubilees 4:3 — *he slew him in the field: and his blood cried from the ground to heaven* the library carries Genesis' crying blood forward (1 John 3:12).

Jubilees 5:6 — *He bade us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold they are bound* the Watchers bound *for ever, until the day of the great condemnation* (Jub 5:10); Jude's everlasting chains unto judgment (Jude 1:6).

Jubilees 4:1 — *And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter ’Âwân.* The book of the fathers keeps the same two births, Cain then Abel, that Adam & Eve sets at its head.

Jubilees 3:28 — *And on that day was closed the mouth of all beasts, and of cattle, and of birds, and of whatever walks, and of whatever moves, so that they could no longer speak: for they had all spoken one with another with one lip and with one tongue.* The serpent stripped of its power to ensnare and silenced among the beasts is the same Eden judgment Jubilees records, when every beast's mouth was closed.

Jubilees 3:27 — *And on that day on which Adam went forth from the garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.* This is the same event — Adam taking spices from paradise to offer on his going forth — recorded in the brother-book.

Jubilees 4:17 — *And he was the first among men that are born on earth who learnt writing and knowledge and wisdom and who wrote down the signs of heaven according to the order of their months in a book.* Enoch the first writer is the pattern of Eve's charge — the antediluvian life set down in a testimony that outlasts the generations.

Jubilees 4:24 — *And on account of it Elohim (God) brought the waters of the flood upon all the land of Eden; for there he was set as a sign and that he should testify against all the children of men, that he should recount all the deeds of the generations until the day of condemnation.* The written record carried through the flood-waters is the very thing Eve plans against the judgement by water.

★ *Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss* (Jubilees 48:14) — the dragon-overthrow Isaiah invokes: *that hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep* (51:10).

*we did not lead forth the children of Yashar'el from Egypt empty handed* (Jubilees 48:19) — the not-empty promise of 3:21-22 kept to the letter in the restored witness; the redeemed brought out laden.

*celebrate it in its season on the fourteenth of the first month* (Jubilees 49:1) — the restored witness keeps *the beginning of months* (12:2) as a fixed appointed season set by Yahuah's commandment.
*roast on the fire: they shall eat it with diligence* (Jubilees 49:13) — the restored witness keeps the manner of eating of 12:8-9: roasted, eaten in earnest, the lamb whole.
*you celebrated this festival with haste when you went forth from Egypt* (Jubilees 49:23) — the girded, hurried eating of *in haste: it is the LORD'S passover* (12:11) remembered.

★ *an eternal ordinance, and engraven on the heavenly tables... ordained for ever* (Jubilees 49:8) — *an ordinance for ever* (12:14): no temporary statute, an everlasting appointed time written in heaven.
*it will come for a memorial well pleasing before Yahuah (God)* (Jubilees 49:15) — the *memorial* of 12:14 received by Yahuah Himself, the appointed remembrance of the going-out.

*the sign of the blood was on its lintels... into (that) house they should not enter to slay* (Jubilees 49:3) — the deliverance of *when he seeth the blood... Yahuah will pass over the door* (12:23) kept whole.
*not break any bone thereof; for of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) no bone shall be crushed* (Jubilees 49:13) — the unbroken-lamb ordinance of 12:46 kept in the covenant memory.

*I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar'el (Israel)... and Yahuah brought them through the midst of the sea as if it were dry land* (Jubilees 48:12) — the Presence between the camps of 14:19-20, in the first person.

*Yahuah our Elohim cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 48:14) — the drowning of 14:28 in the restored witness: the pursuers go down into the deep.

*Six days will you labour, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath of Yahuah your Elohim* (Jubilees 50:7) — the restored witness keeps the same Sabbath-pattern of 16:23, set in the desert of Sinai between Elim and Sinai.

*save that you have prepared for yourselves on the sixth day, so as to eat, and drink, and rest, and keep Sabbath* (Jubilees 50:9) — the exact provision of 16:23: prepare on the sixth, rest on the seventh; the double-gathering is the same ordinance.

*the festival of unleavened bread, that they should eat unleavened bread seven days... that they should observe its festival* (Jubilees 49:21) — the seven-day feast of 13:6 kept as a standing ordinance with joy before Yahuah.

*you celebrated this festival with haste when you went forth from Egypt* (Jubilees 49:23) — echoing *Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt* (13:3): the feast remembers the hurried going-out.
*the glory of Yahuah (God) abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it* (Jubilees 1:2) — the cloud and glory of *a thick cloud upon the mount* (19:16) kept in the restored witness.
*the appearance of the glory of Yahuah (God) was like a flaming fire on the top of the Mount* (Jubilees 1:3) — matches *Yahuah descended upon it in fire* (19:18): the glory and the fire are one.
*as Yahuah (God) spake to Moses on Mount Sinai... "Go up to the top of the Mount"* (Jubilees 1:1) — the descended Yahuah calling Moses up (19:20) to receive the tables of the law.

*I will separate to Myself a people from among all the peoples... they will be My people and I shall be their Elohim (God)* (Jubilees 2:19) — the election the deliverance of 20:2 seals; the commands are the law of a people already His.
*I have chosen the seed of Jacob... and have written him down as My firstborn son... for ever and ever* (Jubilees 2:20) — the redeemed of 20:2 are the firstborn son, the two-house covenant lineage.
*kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works* (Jubilees 2:1) — the restored witness grounds 20:11: a creation sign for all ages.
*these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people* (Jubilees 2:19) — keeping *the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka* (20:10) is the mark of His separated people.

*keep Sabbath from all work on that day... a day of the holy kingdom for all Yashar'el (Israel) is this day among their days for ever* (Jubilees 50:9) — the rest of 20:10 named an everlasting ordinance.
*the glory of Yahuah (God) abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it six days* (Jubilees 1:2) — the glory and the six-day cloud of 24:16 kept verse-for-verse in the restored witness.

*He called to Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud... like a flaming fire on the top of the Mount* (Jubilees 1:3) — the seventh-day call and the fire of 24:16-17; the Sabbath-rhythm on the mount.

*Moses was on the Mount forty days and forty nights, and Elohim (God) taught him... the law and of the testimony* (Jubilees 1:4) — the forty days of 24:18, and what passed there: the law given to be taught.
*the tables of the law and of the commandment... which I have written, that you may teach them* (Jubilees 1:1) — frames the tables of 34:28 as covenant-instruction handed down to be taught.
*they will serve their gods, and these will prove to them an offence... and a snare* (Jubilees 1:9) — the restored witness names the very *snare* of 34:12; mingled worship is the trap.
*I shall build My sanctuary in their midst, and I shall dwell with them* (Jubilees 1:17) — the restored witness keeps the declared intent of *that I may dwell among them* (25:8).

*I know their rebellion and their stiff neck, before I bring them into the land of which I sware to their fathers* (Jubilees 1:7) — Yahuah's own forewarning of *it is a stiffnecked people* (32:9), spoken before ever the calf was made.
*they will turn to strange gods, to (gods) which cannot deliver them* (Jubilees 1:8) — the turning-aside of 32:8; the molten calf is the first of the strange gods that cannot save.
*For they will forget all My commandments... and will serve their gods* (Jubilees 1:9) — to make the calf is to forget the Torah just spoken from the mount (32:8).

*I shall build My sanctuary in their midst, and I shall dwell with them* (Jubilees 1:17) — the restored witness names the purpose the filling Glory (40:34) accomplishes: Yahuah dwelling among His people.

*I shall dwell with them, and I shall be their Elohim (God) and they will be My people* (Jubilees 1:17) — the restored witness keeps the settled purpose of the indwelling (40:34): the Presence among His people, tent to eternity.
Jubilees 2:1 — the Maker *kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it... and appointed it as a sign* — the appointed rest sealing the work.

*…the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy… to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill…* (Jubilees 49:2) — the restored witness names the same firstborn-stroke as the festival night.
*they increased abundantly and multiplied exceedingly... and they became a great nation* (Jubilees 46:1) — the restored witness echoes Exodus 1:7 word for word.
*let us deal wisely with them... else they will join themselves to our enemies* (Jubilees 46:13) — the very policy of Exodus 1:8-10 in the king's mouth.
*he set over them taskmasters... Pithom and Raamses* (Jubilees 46:14) — the restored witness names the same taskmasters and cities.
*the more they dealt evilly with them, the more they increased and multiplied* (Jubilees 46:15) — the paradox of Exodus 1:12 in the restored account.
*cast all their male children which were born into the river* (Jubilees 47:2) — the restored witness names the decree plainly.

*And she made an ark for you, and covered it with pitch and asphalt, and placed it in the flags on the bank of the river* (Jubilees 47:4) — the same *ark... daubed... with slime and with pitch* in *the flags* (Exodus 2:3).
*And she took you out of the ark, and she had compassion on you* (Jubilees 47:6) — mirrors *Because I drew him out of the water* (Exodus 2:10).
*You did see an Egyptian smiting your friend... and you did slay him and hide him in the sand* (Jubilees 47:10) — retelling *he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand* (Exodus 2:12).
*Who made you a prince and a judge over us?... And you did fear and flee on account of these words* (Jubilees 47:11) — the rejected deliverer driven out (Exodus 2:14-15).
*what prince Mastêmâ desired to do with you... at the lodging-place.* (Jubilees 48:2) — the restored witness names the assailant at the inn.
*Did he not with all his power seek to slay you...* (Jubilees 48:3) — Mastema's assault on the man sent to judge Egypt; the covenant blood repels him.
*according to His covenant, which He had ordained with Abraham* (Jubilees 48:7) — the deliverance keeping the oath, "I have remembered my covenant" (Exodus 6:5).
Jubilees 48:14 — *cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss*; measure-for-measure recompense for drowning Israel's children.
*the angel of the presence who went before the camp of Yashar’el* (Jubilees 1:29) — the restored witness names the Name-bearer.
*the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of Yahuah* (Jubilees 2:1) — bearing the Name, sent by the Father.
*kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages* (Jubilees 2:1) — a perpetual sign.

*all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born... from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill* (Jubilees 49:2) — the same night in Exodus's own words.
*the plague came not upon them to destroy... any soul either of cattle, or man, or dog* (Jubilees 49:4) — the dog-distinction named exactly, the plague passing by Israel.

*You did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year. And you did return into Egypt* (Jubilees 48:1) — dates the sojourn behind Gershom's name, *I have been an alien in a strange land* (Exodus 18:3).
*with a stone he had killed Abel, and by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment* (Jubilees 4:31) — the heavenly-tables ordinance of measure-for-measure, written before Sinai.
*Kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works* (Jubilees 2:1) — the restored witness frames the perpetual covenant.
*These will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people* (Jubilees 2:19) — the Sabbath the mark of the separated, sanctified people.
Jubilees 2:21 — the *peculiar people* sanctified *to bless Him who has created all things* — the covenant breath in the Hallelujah.
*I shall build My sanctuary in their midst, and I shall dwell with them* (Jubilees 1:17) — the promise the finished tent makes visible.
Jubilees 31:18 — Isaac's blessing on Judah: *A prince shall you be ... In you be found the salvation of Yashar’el* — the prince Matthew's list delivers.
★ *the prince of the Mastema was bound and imprisoned... that he might not accuse them* (Jubilees 48:15) — the resisting Satan of Zechariah 3:1 bound so the chosen people cannot be accused.
★ *I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them* (Jubilees 1:23) — the heart circumcised, the holy spirit created within: the cleansing of the poured spirit of grace.

★ *now I love Jacob more than Esau, for he has done manifold evil deeds, and there is no righteousness in him* (Jubilees 35:13) — the love and hatred of Malachi 1:2-3 framed by CONDUCT, the guard against reading it as ethnic spite.

Jubilees 2:19 — *...these will keep the Sabbath day, and I will sanctify them to Myself as My people...* The library's witness: the Sabbath is the sign of the sanctified people — given, not taken away.

Jubilees 2:20 — *...and I will teach them the Sabbath day, that they may keep Sabbath thereon from all work.* The Sabbath is taught to be kept for ever — the Son of Adam is its right Lord and Interpreter, not its abolisher.

★ *And He said to him: "So shall your seed be."* (Jubilees 14:5) — the innumerable seed sworn to Abraham is the innumerable house Hosea sees, *as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered* (Hosea 1:10).

★ *I shall be Elohim (God) to you and to your seed after you* (Jubilees 14:6) — the covenant formula Lo-ammi reverses (*I will not be your Elohim (God)*, Hosea 1:9), sworn to Abraham's seed, restored at 1:10.
★ *I shall be their Elohim (God) and they will be My people in truth and righteousness* (Jubilees 1:17) — the restored witness sings the same Lo-ammi reversal of Hosea 2:23.
★ *I shall be their Father and they will be My children* (Jubilees 1:24) — the *bands of love* (Hosea 11:4) are the covenant Father-and-children bond, drawing the heart to His commandments.
★ *I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them* (Jubilees 1:25) — the fatherly love of *with bands of love... and I laid meat unto them* (Hosea 11:4).
★ *I shall gather them from amongst all the nations* (Jubilees 1:15) — the same regathering as the dove brought home and placed in their houses (Hosea 11:11).
*Jacob... gave a tithe of all that came with him* (Jubilees 32:2) — the restored witness keeps the Bethel vow paid. [extras]
Jubilees 2:18 — *all the angels of the presence... He has hidden us to keep the Sabbath with Him in heaven and on earth.* Heaven itself keeps the day; rest full of life, not an empty cessation.

Jubilees 10:8 (extras) — Mastema, chief of the spirits, *came and said* before Yahuah and ASKS for a portion: accusation by permission, the bounded adversary who must request leave, exactly as ha-satan comes *among them* (Job 1:6).
Jubilees 5:1 — *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives* — the Genesis 6 fall recorded; the servants Yahuah put no trust in.

*they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart... I shall gather them from amongst all the nations* (Jubilees 1:15) — the restored witness sings Deuteronomy 4:29-30 nearly verbatim.
Extra-canonical — *I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart... and I shall create in them a holy spirit* (Jubilees 1:23): the Torah-library's own retelling of Horeb resolving Deuteronomy 5:29.
Jubilees 30:11 (extras) -- the restored witness reads Deut 7:3 as standing law: *not to give their daughters to the nations... abominable before Yahuah*.
Jubilees 2:11 — the great sea monsters 'created by His hands' on the fifth day: Behemoth made and therefore wholly His to master.
*I shall gather them from amongst all the nations* (Jubilees 1:15) — the Sinai disclosure retold as Deut 30 itself.
*I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and ... of their seed* (Jubilees 1:23) — almost verbatim Deut 30:6, with the holy spirit added.
*the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah* (Jubilees 10:1) — the powers behind the devils of 32:17.
*do not forsake Your people and Your inheritance* (Jubilees 1:19) — Moses pleads against abandoning the portion of 32:9.
*But they are Your people and Your inheritance... create in them a clean heart* (Jubilees 1:20) — the new-covenant cure for the apostasy.
Jubilees 30:11 (extras) — *not to give their daughters to the nations... for this is abominable before Yahuah (God)*: the holy seed not mingled into the abominations of the nations.
Jubilees 33:10 (extras) — *a man should not lie with his father's wife... ordained on the heavenly tables*: the near-of-kin fence traced to Reuben and Bilhah, ancient and grave.
Jubilees 30:10 (extras) — *because he has given of his seed to Moloch... shall be rooted out*: seed to Moloch binds to defilement and rooting-out; profaning the Name.
Jubilees 30:15 (extras) — *plague upon plague, and curse upon curse... the whole nation together be judged*: defilement unjudged draws the curse on the whole people and land.
Jubilees 4:32 (extras) — the restored witness brings the Adam-to-Noah line to the same three sons (1 Chronicles 1:4).
Jubilees 6:21 — *the feast of weeks and the feast of first-fruits... twofold* — the same fusion, written on the heavenly tables.
Jubilees 16:21 — Abraham *was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth* — the feast rooted in the fathers.
Jubilees 16:29 — *ordained on the heavenly tables... a statute for ever* — the feast of tabernacles ordained for ever, never abolished.
Jubilees 50:2 — *I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and... the jubilee years* — the restored witness binding land-sabbath and jubilee as one calendar.
Jubilees 50:3 — *the land also will keep its sabbaths while they dwell upon it, and they will know the jubilee year* — the land herself a covenant keeper of the rest.
*they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el (Israel)* (Jubilees 31:15) — Yaaqov's blessing marks Levi for the priestly calling.
*Levi... ordained and made him the priest of the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), him and his sons for ever* (Jubilees 32:1) -- the election of Levi behind Numbers 3:6.
*Levi fell to the portion of Yahuah (God), and his father clothed him in the garments of the priesthood* (Jubilees 32:3) -- the wholly-given separation of Numbers 3:9.
Jubilees 1:11 — *they will make to themselves high places and groves and graven images.* The pattern foretold to Moses, which Jeroboam built and staffed in 2 Chronicles 11:15.

threads.title: The genealogy as Adamic toledot
threads.summary_md: Matthew's opening phrase *biblos genéseōs* echoes the Septuagint of Genesis 5:1 — the same toledot the Hebrew library walks at greater chronological depth in Jubilees 4 and at celebratory length in Ecclesiasticus 44 (*Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us*). The Apocalypse of Abraham 20:6 carries the same seed-promise the genealogy traces. 1 Adam-Eve 1:1 opens at the Genesis-garden register the toledot descends from. The framework reads Matt 1:1 as standing in the Hebrew library's own genealogical-celebration tradition — not first-century pedigree records, but the canon-opening toledot register the prophets and the Hebrew library always walked.

threads.title: The Matthean Yoseph and the patriarch Yoseph
threads.summary_md: The Yoseph (Joseph) of Matthew 1:18-25 / 2:13-15 / 2:20 carries the role of the patriarchal-Yoseph in Genesis 37-50: the dreamer, the one who carries the seed of promise down into Egypt, the preserver of the covenant line through a hostile king. The Testament of Yoseph (Testaments XII chapters 72-87) — the patriarch's deathbed testament — supplies the extras-tier Hebrew-library framing for the typological pattern. Jubilees 46 walks the Egypt sojourn the Matthean Yoseph's flight telescopes. The Matthean Yoseph is named *son of David* by the angel because he carries both lines into the child he will name — Davidic legal lineage and Yoseph-patriarchal preservation role.

threads.title: Yashar'el (Israel) the firstborn — the creation-anchor of the Egypt-call
threads.summary_md: Jubilees 2:20 — at the creation register — names the seed of Ya'aqov (Jacob) as Yahuah's firstborn son before any historical event: *I have chosen the seed of Ya'aqov (Jacob) from amongst all that I have seen, and have written him down as My firstborn son, and have sanctified him to Myself for ever and ever.* The Hosea 11:1 / Exodus 4:22 firstborn-identification Matt 2:15 walks rests on this prior creation-anchor in the Hebrew library. Yashar'el is firstborn before the world; the call out of Egypt is the historical actualization of an eternal designation; Yahusha (Jesus) is the firstborn-Yashar'el embodied at every chronological register the Hebrew library carries.

threads.title: Rachel buried at Beth-lehem — the geographic anchor of the weeping
threads.summary_md: Jubilees 32:33-34 names the death of Rachel in childbirth at Ephrath, *the same is Beth-lehem,* with her tomb on the road above her grave. The Jeremiah 31:15 *Rachel weeping for her children* that Matthew 2:18 quotes is geographically anchored exactly where the Beth-lehem slaughter falls and where the Messianic child is being protected. The matriarchal weeping is not a poetic flourish but a geographic fact: the tomb of the matriarch sits on the road where the children are killed and the deliverer escapes. The extras-tier Hebrew-library witness locks the geography the inherited canon compresses.

threads.title: The Watcher rebellion as the source of the vipers
threads.summary_md: Yochanan's (John's) *generation of vipers* — Greek *gennēmata echidnōn,* offspring of vipers — at Matt 3:7 names the Pharisaic-Sadducean leadership in the seed-war register the Hebrew library opens at 1 Enoch 6-16 and Jubilees 5 / 10. 1 Enoch 6:1-2 narrates the fallen-Watchers' descent and their breeding of the Nephilim — the tares woven in by the fallen Watchers (Matt 13:24-30, 36-43). 1 Enoch 10:9 names the judgment against *the children of the Watchers* explicitly. Jubilees 5:1 carries the same narrative; Jubilees 10:1 narrates the persistence of the Watcher-spirits as unclean demons after the Flood. The seed-war pattern Yochanan (John) names at Matt 3:7 — and Yahusha (Jesus) re-names at Matt 23:33 and John 8:44 — has this 1 Enoch 6 / Jubilees 5 origin in the Hebrew library's witness. The system is the contemporary face of the persistent seed-war; the people inside are victims of the deception their inherited tradition handed them.

threads.title: The temptation as Mastema architecture
threads.summary_md: Matt 4:1-7's *tempted of the devil* sits inside the Hebrew library's named Mastema architecture from Jubilees. Jubilees 10:8 names Mastema as the chief-of-evil-spirits with an authorized role to lead astray and judge. Jubilees 11:5 names Mastema's standing disruption-of-the-bread-supply pattern (the ravens sent to eat the sown seed) — the architecture Matt 4:3's stones-to-bread temptation walks at the Messianic level. Jubilees 17:16 names Mastema's role at the Aqedah — the accuser-figure provoking the testing-of-the-righteous-Son to prove the Sonship-claim by visible-sign — the same architecture Matt 4:5-7's temple-pinnacle test walks. Avraham (Abraham) was tested with Yitschaq (Isaac); Yahusha (Jesus) is tested with himself. The Hebrew library names the figure and the testing-architecture the gospel inherits.

threads.title: The heavenly tablets and the permanence of the Torah
threads.summary_md: Matt 5:17-18's load-bearing declaration — *think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil. For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law* — binds the gospel to the Hebrew library's heavenly-tablets architecture. Jubilees 6:35 names the architecture explicitly: *the book (lies) written before me, and on the heavenly tables the division of days is ordained.* The Torah and the appointed times are inscribed before Yahuah (God) from the foundation of the world; what Yahusha (Jesus) binds himself to at Matt 5:18 is what Jubilees named as already standing on the heavenly tables. Jubilees 6:37 names the prophetic warning against those who will *disturb the order* — abomination-protecting redaction that confounds the holy with the unclean. The King's *one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass* stands against the same disturbance the Hebrew library has already prophesied.

threads.title: Spirits from the giants and the demons partially restrained — 1 Enoch 15-16 and Jubilees 10
threads.summary_md: When the two demoniacs at Gergesa cry out, *what have we to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God)? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?* (Matthew 8:29), they are speaking as creatures who know where they came from and what day is waiting for them. The book of Enoch tells both. The spirits that trouble men are the spirits of the giants, the children the Watchers begot on the daughters of men: *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* (1 Enoch 15:9). Their work on the earth is named without softening: *And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.* (1 Enoch 15:11). And they have a day fixed for them, which they know: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). Jubilees carries the story past the flood, when *the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* (Jubilees 10:1), and tells how their chief pleaded to keep a portion of them loose: *the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me ... for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men.* (Jubilees 10:8). A tenth part was left him, subject before Satan on the earth, and the rest were bound in the place of condemnation (Jubilees 10:11). So the fear in the demons' mouth at Matthew 8:29 is not a strange outburst. They are the spirits of the giants, left loose for a season, and the one standing in front of them is the Judge of the day Enoch said they would destroy until. They know the time has not yet come, and they know who sets it.

threads.title: The restoration of the age to come — 1 Enoch 5 and 10, Jubilees 23
threads.summary_md: When John sends from prison to ask whether he is the one, Yahusha (Jesus) answers with what is happening in front of the messengers: *The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.* (Matthew 11:5). It is Isaiah's list: *Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.* (Isaiah 35:5). And it is a taste of an age the library had already described in full. Enoch tells what is kept for the elect once the judgment has passed: *And for you the godless there shall be a curse. But for the elect there shall be light and joy and peace, And they shall inherit the earth.* (1 Enoch 5:7). *And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride: But they who are wise shall be humble.* (1 Enoch 5:8). *And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life. And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life.* (1 Enoch 5:9). The same promise is given to Noah's seed after the Watchers are bound: *And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.* (1 Enoch 10:17). *And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.* (1 Enoch 10:18). Jubilees 23 says the same of the last days, long life, peace and joy, no Satan and no destroyer, and healing. What John's messengers saw was that age reaching back into theirs, the blind and lame and dead already being handled the way the whole earth will be handled. The day of vengeance in the same breath of Isaiah 61 he left unread, because that part waits for his return.

threads.title: The new heart, the cleansing spirit, and the children of the living Elohim — Jubilees 1:23-25
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:11's *he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he* (the kingdom-citizens' transformation-of-status exceeding the highest of the prophetic-tradition) — read against Jubilees 1:23-25's wisdom-stream Tanakh-anchor parallel to Jeremiah 31:33 and Ezekiel 36:26-27. Three direct moves: Jubilees 1:23 names the heart-circumcision and the creation of the holy-spirit and the cleansing-that-does-not-turn-away (the new-heart Tanakh-promise); Jubilees 1:24 names the souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah (God) and the fulfilling-of-the-commandments and the Father-and-children-relation (the substance of the new-heart); Jubilees 1:25 names the *children of the living Elohim (God)* designation — the same phrase Hosea 1:10 names for the Lo-Ammi scattered-seed gathered-home and the same phrase Paul cites at Romans 9:25-26. The framework reads the verse-cluster as one architecture: the new-heart-Spirit-cleansing substance produces the scattered-seed gathered-home as children-of-the-living-Elohim (God). Matt 11:11 names the operative-fact of the architecture coming-to-pass at the kingdom's inauguration — what the prophets served from outside the indwelling-Ruach (Spirit), the kingdom-citizens carry from inside it.

threads.title: Sodom as the enduring judgment-archetype — Jubilees 16:5-9 and Wisdom of Solomon 10:6-8
threads.summary_md: Matt 11:23-24's *more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of Sodom-as-the-enduring-judgment-archetype. Three moves: Jubilees 16:5 names the direct destruction-narrative — Yahuah (God) executed judgment on Sodom, Gomorrah, Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, burning them with fire-and-brimstone until-this-day; Jubilees 16:6 names the architectural-application — *Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom* (Sodom as template for future-judgments); Wisdom of Solomon 10:7 names the enduring-monument — *the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and ... a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 11:23-24: the King invokes the most-canonical-judgment-archetype to lock the graduated-accountability for Kfar-Nachum (Capernaum). Sodom is the floor; the cities-that-saw-the-credential-and-rejected face the sharper application. The framework's reading of *hell* as *hadēs* / *Sheol* (the underworld of the dead, the Tanakh's *Sheol* substance) rules out the inherited Christian eternal-conscious-torment overlay.

threads.title: The Shabbat as covenant-sign and protected-day with life-saving-defense override — Jubilees 2, Jubilees 50, and 1 Maccabees 2
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:1-14's Shabbat-controversies — the disciples-plucking-grain at vv.1-8 with the *Son of Adam is Lord even of the Shabbat* declaration AND the synagogue-Shabbat-healing of the man-with-the-withered-hand at vv.9-14 with the *kal vachomer* sheep-rescue argument at vv.11-12 — read against the wisdom-stream's Shabbat-substance architecture. Four moves: Jubilees 2:17 names the Shabbat as the *great sign* of the covenant — the same covenant-sign substance Exodus 31:13 names; Jubilees 2:21 names the Shabbat as the day-of-eating-and-drinking-and-blessing — explicitly the opposite of the Pharisaic-fence-architecture's reading of restrictive-against-eating; Jubilees 50:12 names the late-Jubilees Shabbat-prohibition code that documents the Second-Temple stringency the Pharisaic-fence inherited and intensified; 1 Maccabees 2:41 names the Hasmonean Shabbat-defense decision that life-saving-overrides-Shabbat-restriction was the operative-principle the wisdom-stream itself had locked under threat of extinction. The framework reads the cluster as locking the framework's reading of Matt 12:1-14 against the institutional-Christian Sunday-Law tradition: the King restores the Shabbat-substance against both the Pharisaic-fence-architecture AND any reading that takes *Lord of the Shabbat* as authorization to abolish what the wisdom-stream witnesses as the covenant-sign Yahuah (God) himself established at Bereshit (Genesis) 2:3 and Exodus 31:13.

threads.title: The binding of the Watchers — Azazel bound hand and foot, and the strong man bound
threads.summary_md: *But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you. Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.* (Matthew 12:28-29). The picture of a strong one bound so that his house can be plundered was not drawn fresh for the Pharisees. It is how the Watchers were dealt with, and the library had told it in detail: *And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein. And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light. And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.* (1 Enoch 10:4-6). The chains were not for him alone: *And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.* (1 Enoch 54:5). Jubilees tells why there are still spirits to cast out at all: *And we did according to all His words: all the malignant evil ones we bound in the place of condemnation, and a tenth part of them we left that they might be subject before Satan on the earth.* (Jubilees 10:11). The devils Yahusha (Jesus) drives out are that tenth, the loose remainder of a host already mostly in chains, and the one they serve is the strong man whose binding is still ahead: *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years, And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.* (Revelation 20:2-3). When the King empties a man of a devil by the Spirit, the house is being spoiled by the one who has the authority to bind its master. That is why he could say the kingdom had come upon them.

threads.title: No forgiveness for the hardened heart — Jubilees 15, 1 Enoch 65, Wisdom of Solomon 12
threads.summary_md: *And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.* (Matthew 12:32). The men he says this to have just watched the Spirit cast out a demon and called it the work of Beelzebub. They saw the thing clearly and named it the devil's, and that is the hardening the library already knew had no road back from it. Enoch was told it about the ones who had learned the Watchers' secrets and would not turn: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11). Jubilees names the same wrath for the ones who set the covenant aside on purpose: *there will be great wrath from Yahuah (the Lord) ... because they have forsaken His covenant and have turned aside from His word* (Jubilees 15:33-34). And the Wisdom of Solomon says why the patience ran out on the Canaanites: he gave them place for repentance, not being ignorant that their malice was bred in them and that their way of thinking would never change (Wisdom of Solomon 12:10). None of these is about a slip of the tongue. They are about a settled refusal, eyes open, that has made up its mind against the correction. That is why the one who fears he has committed this sin almost certainly has not; the fear is a conscience still working, and a hardened heart does not lie awake over it.

threads.title: Resurrection from Sheol — the gates of the dead give back what they received — the sign of Yonah in Wisdom of Solomon 16, 1 Enoch 51, Jubilees 23
threads.summary_md: They ask for a sign and he gives them one they cannot see yet: *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* (Matthew 12:40). Three days and three nights in the heart of the earth means Sheol, and coming out of it means Sheol gave him back, and the library had been saying for a long time that Sheol will give back. Solomon says it of Yahuah (God): *thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again* (Wisdom of Solomon 16:13). Enoch says it of the day the Elect One takes the throne: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1). *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). Jubilees promises the servants that *the Lord will heal His servants, And they shall rise up and see great peace* (Jubilees 23:30). The sign of Yonah is the King announcing that he himself will go down through those gates first and be brought up, the firstfruits of what Enoch saw the earth and Sheol do for everyone entrusted to them. The count is a real count. Three days and three nights is what he said, and the Friday evening to Sunday morning the tradition settled on does not hold three nights, which is one more reason to read the week of his death by the calendar of the feasts rather than by the calendar handed down.

threads.title: Adam and the inherited evil-heart needing the new-heart cleansing — the empty-house parable architecture — 2 Esdras 7 and Jubilees 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:43-45's unclean-spirit-returning empty-house parable — *when the unclean spirit is gone out of a man ... when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished. Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself ... and the last state of that man is worse than the first* — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Adam-inherited-evil-heart needing the new-heart-cleansing. Three moves: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:48 names the inherited-from-Adam architecture — *O Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee*; 2 Esdras 7:118 restates the architecture explicitly; Jubilees 1:23 names the wisdom-stream's direct Tanakh-anchor parallel to Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33 and Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 — *I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:43-45: the cleansed-house empty-of-the-new-heart is the architecture Jubilees 1:23's new-heart-and-holy-spirit-and-cleansing-substance describes by its negative-correlate — deliverance-without-internal-replacement leaves the children-of-Adam without the internal-substance, vulnerable to deeper bondage. The institutional-Christian altar-call-without-Torah-substance conversion-pattern walks the same structural-vulnerability — old bondage removed, new house left empty because the antinomian-reading of the gospel that produced the conversion removed the heart-Torah-walking life as the internal-furnishing the new-heart-substance places. Kefa's (Peter's) apostolic restatement at 2 Peter 2:20-21 names the same architecture: *the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.*

threads.title: Children of Elohim by doing the Father's will — the son-of-the-Most-High identity-marker — Wisdom of Solomon 2, Sirach 4, Jubilees 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:46-50's kingdom-family-redefinition closing — *whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother* — read against the wisdom-stream's children-of-Elohim-by-doing-the-Father's-will architecture. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:13-15 names the child-of-Elohim-by-the-righteous-disposition architecture — *he calleth himself the child of Yahuah (the Lord) ... his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion*; Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 names the son-of-Elohim-tested-by-deliverance architecture — *if the just man be the son of Elohim (God), he will help him*; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 4:10 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the doing-the-Father's-substance-makes-thee-a-son architecture — *be as a father unto the fatherless ... so shalt thou be as the son of the most High*; Jubilees 1:24 names the souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah-and-fulfilling-the-commandments yields the Father-and-children-relation architecture — *they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:50: the kingdom-family-recognition-criterion is the same doing-the-Father's-will substance the wisdom-stream had named as the operative-form of the son-of-the-Most-High identity. The same criterion is the kingdom-entry-criterion at Matt 7:21 (*not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father*), and the 1 John 2:3-4 master-filter restates it: *if we keep his commandments.* The wisdom-stream and the gospel name one architecture across two registers — the kingdom-family is identified by the heart-Torah-walking-disposition the prophets named, the wisdom-stream named, and the King names operative in the kingdom's inauguration.

threads.title: The fowls that devour the seed — Mastema's birds and the spirits of the Watchers
threads.summary_md: In the parable the seed by the wayside is lost when *fowls came and devoured them up* (Matthew 13:4), and the King does not leave the birds as scenery. He tells us who they are: *When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.* (Matthew 13:19). Jubilees had already put birds in the adversary's hand, sent against the seed in the days of Abraham's father: *Prince Mastema sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, so as to rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked it from the surface of the ground* (Jubilees 11:11). And Enoch names the spirits that do the robbing, where they came from and what they are working toward: *And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.* (1 Enoch 19:1). Abraham drove the fowls off his sacrifice (Genesis 15:11); Mastema sent them against the furrows; the wicked one sends them against the heart where the word of the kingdom has just been sown. It is one enemy with one aim, to take the seed before it can root, and the same birds come back later in the chapter to lodge in the branches of the mustard tree, because what grows in the field grows with the enemy still working in it until the harvest.

threads.title: The Watchers' corruption as tares sown in the wheat — 1 Enoch 6, 10, 15 and Jubilees 5, 7 beside Matthew 13:25-39
threads.summary_md: *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.* (Matthew 13:25). When the disciples ask what it means, Yahusha (Jesus) says the tares are a seed with a father: *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.* (Matthew 13:38-39). Enoch records the sowing. *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* (1 Enoch 6:2). Two hundred of them swore it on Hermon in the days of Jared, and what they begot was a line, not a mood: *And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): 'Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.* (1 Enoch 10:9). Their bodies died in the flood but their spirits stayed: *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). Jubilees is the second witness: *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1), and Noah tells his sons that the flood came *owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all which they chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.* (Jubilees 7:21). So the children of the wicked one are a seed sown into the world, and the parable is not a figure of speech about bad attitudes. But hold the other half of it just as firmly. The seed runs inside every people, not along the lines of any nation or color, and Eli's own sons were sons of Belial; nobody can sort the field by looking at it. That is why the servants are told to let both grow together. The sorting belongs to the reapers at the harvest, and to no one else.

threads.title: The seed war from Genesis 3 forward, with the devil as the source of death — Wisdom of Solomon 2:24, 1 Enoch 22, Jubilees 4
threads.summary_md: *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38). *The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.* (Matthew 13:39). Two seeds in one field, and the devil the one who sowed the second. The library had been saying this since the garden. Solomon names the devil as the source of death itself: *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:24). The first fruit of that seed was Cain, and Enoch was shown his brother's spirit still crying out: *I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.* (1 Enoch 22:5). *Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’* (1 Enoch 22:6). *And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’* (1 Enoch 22:7). Abel's suit is against a seed, not only a man. Jubilees tells the murder the way Genesis does, *Qayin (Cain) slew Hevel (Abel) because (God) accepted the sacrifice of Hevel (Abel), and did not accept the offering of Qayin (Cain) ... and his blood cried from the ground to heaven* (Jubilees 4:2), and John names which seed Cain was: *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.* (1 John 3:12). So the parable is not a new idea about the world. The serpent in the garden, the envy that brought death in, the Watchers' corruption, the tares in the field, and the harvest where the angels sort them are one story, and Abel's voice has been making suit through all of it until the seed that killed him is gone from among the seed of men.

threads.title: The seed of promise specifically to Yashar'el (Israel) — not to the other seed of Avraham (Abraham) — Jubilees 15 and 16 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:22-28's Canaanite-woman pericope — the King's-children-vs-dogs distinction at v.26 (*it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs*) and the woman's-acceptance-of-the-architecture at v.27 (*Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the seed-of-promise-specifically-to-Yashar'el (Israel)-NOT-to-other-seed-of-Avraham (Abraham) substance. Four moves: Jubilees 15:30 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *for Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar'el (Israel) to be His people* (the wisdom-stream's precise articulation of the seed-distinction the Pharisaic-system's-binary erased and the modern-Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse erases); Jubilees 15:31 names the spiritual-jurisdictional architecture — *for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him* (the *bene Elohim* allocation per Devarim (Deuteronomy) 32:8-9's Septuagint and Dead Sea Scrolls reading); Jubilees 15:32 names the Yashar'el (Israel)-under-direct-rule architecture — *but over Yashar'el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler* (the architecture the King's-mission-to-the-lost-sheep at v.24 enacts under the Father's-direct-shepherding); Jubilees 16:17 names the holy-seed-from-the-sons-of-Yitschaq (Isaac) — *and (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of Yahuah (God) most High* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the holy-seed-from-Yitschaq (Isaac)-NOT-reckoned-among-the-nations architecture). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #7 seed-distinction's wisdom-stream corroboration. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture with explicit-precision centuries before the Pharisaic-binary and the modern-false-inclusion-gospel's seed-collapse arose. The Canaanite-woman is outside the seed-architecture the wisdom-stream had named; the King's-distinction at v.26 operates exactly in the architecture; the woman's-acceptance-at-v.27 honors the architecture; the King's-mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance at v.28 grants-within-the-architecture without collapsing it. The framework reads this in continuity with Romans 9:6-13's *they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel) ... in Yitschaq (Isaac) shall thy seed be called* — Paul's articulation of the same wisdom-stream substance the inherited-Christian reading flattens-to-the-replacement-theology-of-the-church-replacing-Yashar'el (Israel) or the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion-gospel's self-selection-by-belief-and-practice.

threads.title: The Yovel cycle and the year-weeks architecture — Jubilees 50
threads.summary_md: Matt 15:32-39's feeding-of-the-four-thousand with seven-loaves-and-seven-baskets-remaining — paired with the twelve-baskets-of-the-feeding-of-the-five-thousand at Matt 14:20 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Yovel-cycle and year-weeks architecture Jubilees structures the entire-Tanakh-chronology around. Three moves: Jubilees 50:1 names the Sabbath-architecture-revealed-in-the-desert-of-Sinai (*after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai*); Jubilees 50:2 names the jubilee-years-in-the-sabbaths-of-years (*I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years* — the seven-times-seven-years-equals-forty-nine-then-the-fiftieth-year-jubilee substance of Vayikra (Leviticus) 25:8-10); Jubilees 50:4 names the forty-nine-jubilees-from-Adam-until-this-day chronological-architecture (*I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Yovel-substance the seven-baskets-of-the-second-feeding signal at the chapter's-closing-scene. The seven-architecture of the second-feeding signals the Yovel-completion-substance the Jubilees-wisdom-stream had structured the entire-Tanakh-chronology around. The King's-pedagogical-double-feeding (twelve-baskets at Matt 14:20 for the twelve-tribes-gathering; seven-baskets at Matt 15:37 for the Yovel-completion) encodes the architecture's-completion-arc the wisdom-stream had named the chronological-substance for. The framework reads this in continuity with Luke 4:18-21's Natsareth (Nazareth)-synagogue-reading of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 61:1-2's *acceptable year of Yahuah (the LORD)* — the King's-naming-himself as the One the Yovel-substance-proclaims at the gospel-fulfillment.

threads.title: Creation-ordinance marriage and the blessed eunuch — Jubilees 3 + Tobit 8 + Wisdom of Solomon 3 on Matt 19:3-12
threads.summary_md: Matt 19:3-12's divorce-controversy + eunuchs-for-the-kingdom saying — the Pharisees-tempting on the Hillel-vs-Shammai-on-Deuteronomy-24:1-grounds-for-divorce trap; the King's-appeal-behind-Mosheh (Moses)-to-Bereshit (Genesis) 1-2's creation-ordinance with the FRAMEWORK-MAJOR *from the beginning it was not so* substance preserving the Torah-as-concession-to-hardness-of-heart architecture per Red Line #4; the *except-it-be-for-fornication* exception-clause preserving the substantial-sexual-impurity substance Deuteronomy 22:13-21 + Leviticus 20:10-21 already name; the eunuchs-for-the-kingdom saying recognizing voluntary-celibacy-in-kingdom-service as gift-substance some-receive — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the same architectural-substance.
